reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Most trusted and good infrastructure.

review_content.Placements: By collecting information from the seniors, in my course, 80% of students got placed. The highest package in my course is 10 LPA, and the lowest package is 1.24 LPA. Recruiting companies are TCS, Zoho, Infosys, and Wipro. Mostly at Zoho 50% of students got internships in it. Roles offered in my course are IT, software developer, and data science.
review_content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure available in my course are very nice. Wi-Fi facility is very good. Classrooms are neat and clean. We get weekly once library period. We go to lab atleast weekly 8 to 10 labs, and it is very useful. AC facilities are also available in it.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: Such a good college and placements are very good. Moreover, the infrastructure is very good.

review_content.Placements: We are in the final semester. There are about 120 students in my department, and 80 get placed. The highest package is 8 LPA, and the average is 6 LPA. Top companies are Zoho, TCS, Cognizant, Mindtree, Wipro, Hexaware, and many more. Many are offered internships along with full-time employment.
review_content.Infrastructure: There are many facilities available, such as Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, a common library, and also a department library. The quality of infrastructure is very good, and the food is good in the hostel. Medical facilities are available weekly once, and a doctor is present on campus at the respective time.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Honest insights on academics, campus life, cost & career prospects.

review_content.Placements: More than 85 percent of students got placed in our college. The salary package offered is 3 LPA to 8 LPA. Notable companies include Larsen & Toubro Reliance Infrastructure DLF Tata Projects Ltd. Hindustan Construction Company (HCC) Essar Group Jaypee Group and GMR Infrastructure. Additionally 80 percent of students obtain internships annually in various engineering fields. Top roles offered are structural engineering geotechnical engineering transportation engineering and consulting civil engineering.
review_content.Infrastructure: The facilities are available 24/7 and provide a safe and secure environment. The hostel is clean and well maintained with a mess that features a separate dining hall and a well equipped kitchen for student use. The mess serves breakfast lunch evening tea and dinner every day with a weekly menu available from the mess in charge.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: KRCT review - A school life in Tiruchirappalli.

review_content.Placements: The management provides full support in placement training. Around 10% of students from my batch students got placed, with an average salary package of 4 LPA- 5 LPA. Top roles offered are full stack developer, software tester, etc. Multinational companies like Zoho visit our college.
review_content.Infrastructure: I am a day scholar, I don't know much about hostel. I got to know from my friends that the quality of food in a hostel is not good. Sometimes there are insects in hostel food. In classrooms, Wi-Fi is available, but sometimes there is no access to Wi-Fi.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: It is the best college for placements and CGPA, but not for enjoyment.

review_content.Placements: Colleges are providing placement training for students. The companies involved include TCS, Avasoft, Hexaware, and Zoho. These companies are organizing drives for students and allowing them to take time off to attend. So far, only 10 percent of students in my batch have been placed, but the remaining students are expected to secure placements soon. It provides good placements.
review_content.Infrastructure: The college feels are too high for course. The hostel feels are also too high. It's not for all there also financially poor people are there so it's not good. The hostel food is good only when on fresher joins. I don't recommend my juniors to join hostel.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: Satisfied because of faculty members as they are friendly and supportive.

review_content.Placements: Placement opportunities are overall good. Yet, they may not always fully help you secure a good position in companies. Placements offered are average, with some salary packages reaching only 15 LPA. This results in an experience that is not entirely satisfactory.
review_content.Infrastructure: The entire college is covered with Wi-Fi facilities. Labs and classrooms have extraordinary infrastructure. Lab facilities are overall good. However, hostel is below average, and food quality is poor. When freshers join, food is good initially, but quality deteriorates over time.

paragraphs: Ramakrishnan College of Technology admission 2025is open for UG and PG courses. The institute offerstwo coursesatUG and PG levelsi.e.,BTech and MTech.K. Ramakrishnan College of Technologycarried out theonline modeof application. Admission toK. Ramakrishnan College of Technology coursesis entrance-based. The college is affiliated withAnna Universityso they follow the admission norms of the university for admission toBTech and MTech. The following segments are all the information related to theK. Ramakrishnan College of Technology admission, course eligibility, and selection criteria.

K. Ramakrishnan College of Technology admissionto BTech and MTech is based onTNEA counselling and CEETA PGfor BTech and MTech respectively. Eligible candidates can register forTNEA counselling and CEETA exam onlineby visiting their official website. The following table mentionsK. Ramakrishnan College of Technology courseseligibility and selection criteria:

Ramakrishnan College of Technology admissionprocedure has a multi-step process, which has to be filled out by all the candidates to get admission into the institute. It begins with the application, candidates are required to apply and appear for theentrance exam and counsellingfor their desired course. Find below theK. Ramakrishnan College of Technology admission process2025:

Candidates seeking admission to K. Ramakrishnan College of Technology must apply forTNEA counselling and CEETA PGentrance exam for admission to BTech and MTech respectively. Candidates can register themselves by visitingTNEA and CEETA PG official websites.
Step 2: K. Ramakrishnan College of Technology Selection Criteria

After applying for the TNEA counselling and CEETA entrance exam, candidates are required to appear for the same to fill out the selection criteria for admission. Additionally, they must also fill out the basic eligibility criteria which include that UG candidates must passClass 12 with 45% aggregateandPG candidatesmust have agraduation degree with 50% aggregate.
For admission to BTech course, it is mandatory to appear in the TNEA counselling round. Candidates are required to register on the official website of
After the final round, the institute releases the merit list of selected candidates. Candidates are required to submit the admission fee to lock the final seat.

reviews_list.review_title: It's a good college with a good placement. This college does not have much enjoyment.

review_content.Placements: Students with an attendance of over 80% are more likely to be placed. Based on my knowledge, the highest salary package for IT jobs is 12 lakhs per annum, while the highest for core branches is 6 lakhs per annum. The average salary package is around 4 lakhs per annum, and the lower packages tend to be lower than this. The top recruiters in the field include DAMS Agri Industries and JAIN Irrigation. review_summary.college_name: KIT - KalaignarKarunanidhi Institute of Technology Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Review of KIT College in Coimbatore.

content.Placements: Placement opportunity at this college was very good. Students got various placement opportunities after completing their degree. Big companies will come and hire students, and offer them various packages of Rs 1 LPA, and some will start their own startups.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure of the college was very good. Classrooms were ventilated, and washrooms were also clean. Classrooms were smart with whiteboards, and the college building was also very big. Campus of college was also big, and whole college was under the camera surveillance.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Biotechnology - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Good placements in 2025 with high packages.

content.Placements: Students are placed for good package salary with the help of the better placement training provided. Companies like Zifo and Biocon provide job offers and also internships. While many graduates enter into core biotech roles, some pursue higher studies, and some transfer to IT/data science.
content.Infrastructure: The department has a well-equipped laboratory and classrooms also have smartboards and Wi-Fi. In the library, we can able to access to review many research papers. Hostel is very clean and more secure space designed for students. The food provided in the hostel is very good.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Agriculture Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: It's a good college with a good placement. This college does not have much enjoyment.

content.Placements: Students with an attendance of over 80% are more likely to be placed. Based on my knowledge, the highest salary package for IT jobs is 12 lakhs per annum, while the highest for core branches is 6 lakhs per annum. The average salary package is around 4 lakhs per annum, and the lower packages tend to be lower than this. The top recruiters in the field include DAMS Agri Industries and JAIN Irrigation. Almost all students need to complete internships. The top role available is in farm machinery.
content.Infrastructure: The college provides facilities such as labs that are somewhat average. Classrooms are average. The library is also average as compared to other departments. The hostel is so good and jolly. Mess food is above average and the canteen is okay. Medical facilities are not available inside the campus, if it's serious they will take to the KMCH sulur.

individual_reviews.course: B.E in CSE (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Good placements in 2025. But bad in infrastructure and mess food.

content.Placements: Literally 50% of the students are being placed. The remaining are not placed maybe because of their history of arrears or some other reason. The highest package is 52 LPA, and the lowest salary is 6 LPA to 9 LPA. Autodesk and Hashai are the top recruiting companies. Mostly 95% of students get internships because it is mandatory. So in the 3rd year, they somehow managed to get an intern. The rest of the students are being tried for it, and do something not sure about it. I am not sure about the roles they are placed maybe like software engineers.
content.Infrastructure: To talk about facilities in the class. There are smart TVs and interactive sessions conducted most of the time. We have Wi-Fi all the time. Library is a good aesthetic place for pics. The overview may be good but not the others like hostel is not that good to say. But have both non-AC and AC hostels separately. Mess and canteen foods are sometimes horrible but it is good most of the time. Sports and games support from college is good enough to participate and go somewhere out for it.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: It has really good infrastructure and facilities.

content.Placements: Around 88% of students got placed in EEE. The highest package is 16 LPA, and the lowest package is 3 LPA. The average package is 6 LPA. Top recruiters included L&T, Siemens, ABB, and Tata Power. Nearly 80% of students got internships at NTPC, BHEL, and GE. Roles offered are design engineer, system engineer, and analyst.
content.Infrastructure: EEE has state-of-the-art labs, interactive classrooms, and seamless Wi-Fi access. The library is well-resourced. Hostels are spacious and secure. Food in the mess is okay with a decent variety. Medical help is available. Sports infrastructure is well-maintained and engaging.

reviews.review_heading: Review of KIT College in Coimbatore.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of the college was very good. Classrooms were ventilated, and washrooms were also clean. Classrooms were smart with whiteboards, and the college building was also very big. Campus of college was also big, and whole college was under the camera surveillance.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements in 2025 with high packages.
reviews.review_text: The department has a well-equipped laboratory and classrooms also have smartboards and Wi-Fi. In the library, we can able to access to review many research papers. Hostel is very clean and more secure space designed for students. The food provided in the hostel is very good.

reviews.review_heading: It's a good college with a good placement. This college does not have much enjoyment.
reviews.review_text: The college provides facilities such as labs that are somewhat average. Classrooms are average. The library is also average as compared to other departments. The hostel is so good and jolly. Mess food is above average and the canteen is okay. Medical facilities are not available inside the campus, if it's serious they will take to the KMCH sulur.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements in 2025. But bad in infrastructure and mess food.
reviews.review_text: To talk about facilities in the class. There are smart TVs and interactive sessions conducted most of the time. We have Wi-Fi all the time. Library is a good aesthetic place for pics. The overview may be good but not the others like hostel is not that good to say. But have both non-AC and AC hostels separately. Mess and canteen foods are sometimes horrible but it is good most of the time. Sports and games support from college is good enough to participate and go somewhere out for it.

reviews.review_heading: It has really good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: EEE has state-of-the-art labs, interactive classrooms, and seamless Wi-Fi access. The library is well-resourced. Hostels are spacious and secure. Food in the mess is okay with a decent variety. Medical help is available. Sports infrastructure is well-maintained and engaging.

reviews.review_heading: It is good for placements. Other activities are very good. It is value for money.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is slow, and labs are maintained properly. Smart boards are available in classrooms. Other facilities are average at our college. It should improve the hostel food and add one more canteen. Sports and medical facilities are average in our college. Books are maintained properly in the library.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college I have ever seen.
reviews.review_text: The college is the best and it has a good quality of the hostel. The quality of food is super. Sports and games are encouraged in this college. I recommend students join this college. The hostel has a separate gym, and it is under CCTV surveillance 24x7. The maintenance of the hostel is so disciplined.

reviews.review_heading: KIT is a good college that provides so many opportunities both academically and other activities.
reviews.review_text: Our college infrastructure is so good. Our campus is a Wi-Fi campus. Different labs are there to help in our education. There are so many opportunities for those who have good ideas and skills. Extracurricular activities are also encouraged.

reviews.review_heading: Infrastructure is so good.
reviews.review_text: Auditorium is very big with AC and comfortable to see all the programs. Hostel is very neat and clean with AC, and also non-AC is available in this college. Classrooms are comfortable to study in and are also equipped with a smart board. The food is so tasty, tea, and snacks are amazing

reviews.review_heading: Amazing campus, great learning experiences, and good placement rate.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are spacious and equipped with smart boards projectors. Wi-Fi-high-speed internet is available across the campus and inside the hostel. There is a modern lab with upgraded equipment. There are clean and hygienic rooms with 24/7 water and power supply, and a separate hostel for boys and girls. The mess food is hygienic and has multiple options. Doctors are available. All types of sports are available.

reviews.review_heading: The review was carried out by a committee that has not been approved.
reviews.review_text: The campus has excellent infrastructure with modern classrooms, well-equipped labs, and high-speed Wi-Fi facilities. Libraries are stocked with updated books, journals, and e-resources. Hostel facilities are also very good with clean rooms, 24/7 security, hygienic food in mess, and recreational areas provided.

reviews.review_heading: My college is worth it for placement.
reviews.review_text: The quality of hostel facilities can vary widely. Some hostels offer well-maintained rooms, study areas, Wi-Fi, and recreational space. Medical facilities in hostels are typically basic with first-aid kits and a nurse or doctor available for emergencies.

reviews.review_heading: The college has good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is good, consisting of AC and non-AC accommodations, with good washrooms and drinking water. They even provide a gym facility and small vending machines, which help us at night whenever we feel hungry.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and teaching.
reviews.review_text: The hostel offers room options with a common area, free Wi-Fi, and purified drinking water. Vegetarian and non-vegetarian food are available in the mess. The hostel facilities for boys and girls are excellent, with clean drinking water, a gym, and medical facilities. The classrooms have well-maintained high-speed Wi-Fi.

reviews.review_heading: KIT - (First step towards a great Success).
reviews.review_text: The faculty are the backbone of the students' success, as they constantly guide students with upcoming and current technology and help them enhance their skills. Their support and the study pattern are really what it takes for students to achieve great heights in their lives. Wi-Fi, labs, and the classroom environment are very good and helpful. The hostel and canteen food and environment are good, with time to interact with other students from various branches.

individual_reviews.title: Review of Karpagam college of engineering, Coimbatore.

content.Placements: The college provides good facilities. So far, we have recorded a 90% placement rate. Placement offers rely on students' interests. Our college students have been placed in top MNC companies, and IT companies thrive well in their respective fields.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is basically good, with greenery surrounding it. Every block is neat and clean. Every floor has water dispenser facilities. The classrooms have world-class infrastructure with smart facilities. The hostel rooms are located in a ventilated place, and the rooms are neat and clean.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Placements are good and challenging college.

content.Placements: 90 percent of students got placed in my course. The highest salary package is 10 LPA, and the lowest salary package offered is 2.8 LPA. The top recruiting companies are TCS, Infosys, and Amazon. Around 75 percent of students got internship. The top roles are product manager and financial manager.
content.Infrastructure: The college infrastructure and facilities are good. The classrooms and labs are good. Many technical and financial books are available in the library. The Wi-Fi facility is also available. The hostel facilities are good. The food is good, and canteen is also available. The medical facilities are available.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering (Cyber Security) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Really good college for studies, excellent infrastructure, and also good placement in 2025.

content.Placements: Above 70% students were placed in my college. Highest package is 48 LPA in 2025, and lowest package is 3-5 LPA. In my course CSE (Cyber Security), currently, no companies are interested because all companies already have cyber analytics. Percentage doesn't matter at all, but you have no history of arrears and also have good coding skills to be placed. Top companies are Zoho, TCS, PayPal, etc. Data analysis and network analysis are the roles offered.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is provided all around the college. Also, good infrastructure for studies. Library is open till 6 pm. Hostels are good, and food is average. Quality of the facilities is good, and they also have good knowledge about the course they teach. In food court, food is good and affordable. Many games are available, like football, hockey, throwball, cricket, kabbadi, etc.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Good placements in 2025, and a nice environment.

content.Placements: I am from the 2021-2025 batch of the AD department. Around 70% of our department students got placed in campus interviews. The placement training is good and knowledgeable. The highest package is 15 LPA, and the lowest is 3.5 LPA. Many top companies have visited our college from A to Z. Various roles are offered like SDE, Full stack, system engineer, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Labs are renovated, computers are updated, and systems are good. The library is equipped with good books and is easy to access. Mess and canteen food are manageable. Sports is really good, as many events were conducted during the time. Gym facilities are provided inside the campus with the required amount of equipment.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: It is a better college, and students can join it.

content.Placements: Placements are average. Around 60% of students got placed. The highest package is decent, but the average is on the lower side. Few top companies visited. Internships are limited, mostly through personal efforts. Roles offered are not always core-related. Joining is not that much the best.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is only for the hostel. Labs are not impressed. Classrooms are not impressionable, and there are separate blocks for the library. The mess food is below average. We should go 2 kilometers from the college for medical facilities. Sports and games are available every semester, and cricket and other sports preferences are there, so students can go for it.

reviews.review_heading: Good but needs more improvement, like other colleges, like more extracurricular activities.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is clean and well maintained with good hygiene and a pleasant environment. Rooms and surroundings are clean. The quality of food is disappointing as it lacks taste and variety of items. This area needs improvement.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, it is the best college for MBA.
reviews.review_text: The facilities at our college are excellent. There is always high-speed Wi-Fi available on campus and in every classroom. Every lab, library, and classroom has contemporary amenities. Professors use projectors to instruct us. Although the canteen offers a wide range of meals, the quality of the food is good. Additional medical amenities are provided. This organization offers a range of sports.

reviews.review_heading: See the truth yourself before admitting your child to a college.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure for the computer science department is very disappointing. Labs are outdated, with limited working systems. There is poor access to updated tools or real-time project environment. Wi-Fi is unreliable and often restricted. Classrooms are basic, and library lacks current CS reference books.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, the best college for the MCA course.
reviews.review_text: Our college’s infrastructure was subpar, although improvements were being considered. Wi-Fi facility had a capacity of 35 Mbps. Libraries lacked a suitable collection of books. The mess facilities of Ramanujan Boys Hostel were adequate, but the meals served were unhygienic. There was a clinic on campus, but, most of medications prescribed by doctors had to be purchased elsewhere.

reviews.review_heading: It is just like a school, not a college.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi facilities are available. The MBA section has AC, and both AC and non-AC options are available. The infrastructure is good, and the library is well-equipped, but some labs do not have Wi-Fi for personal devices. Medical facilities are available. The canteen has average infrastructure but offers good quality food. Non-veg meals are served on Sundays and Wednesdays. There is also a gym for students to work out.

reviews.review_heading: M. Kumarasamy College of Engineering is absolutely the best engineering college.
reviews.review_text: This college's infrastructure and campus environment are excellent. More than 15 courses are available in this college. Multiple laboratories and more spacious classrooms are here in this college. A well-stocked library is also here in this college. This college's sports ground facilities are very good, and the coaching staff also work in this college. Hostel food quality is also good. Canteen facilities are also available on this college campus.

reviews.review_heading: One of the best colleges for MCA.
reviews.review_text: Our college infrastructure is very good. High-speed Wi-Fi is available in every classroom and throughout the campus. All labs, libraries, and classrooms are equipped with modern facilities. Professors use projectors to teach us. The food quality is good, and a variety of food is available in the canteen. Medical facilities are also available. The institution offers various sports.

reviews.review_heading: Panimalar Engineering College is an excellent place to explore.
reviews.review_text: Our college has two canteens inside the campus. The toilets are not hygienic. They follow infrastructure norms once every four years due to NAAC inspections. The classrooms are good. It has a good environment and less space for parking. After this, there is a good hostel and college.

reviews.review_heading: Top engineering college in Karur.
reviews.review_text: It's a green, peaceful environment, and a good place to do our higher studies. This place stabilizes the mental health of our students. The foods are available in higher quality and make us feel at home. The sports grounds are too large, and students can practice their interests.

reviews.review_heading: M. Kumarasamy College of Engineering is a really good college.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is very beautiful. CCTV cameras are installed in this college so nobody can move without a permission in this college. Facilities like that of laboratories and library are made available by the college. The hostel facility provided is good. The food in the mess is hygienic.

reviews.review_heading: M. Kumarasamy college of engineering is a good college.
reviews.review_text: M. Kumarasamy College of Engineering Infrastructure is very awesome. Free Wi-Fi is available at this college campus. More computer labs with internet facilities. The biggest library is also available at this college. Separate hostels with air-conditioned rooms. Mess and canteen foods are very hygienic.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure, good faculty members and placements.
reviews.review_text: Every classroom has a projector for easy understanding through PPT, and first-year classes have smart classes for better understanding. The food in the canteen and mess is really good, and the food in the canteen is affordable for all students and tastes good.

reviews.review_heading: Mostly satisfied with the teaching and placement.
reviews.review_text: The college does not provide any Wi-Fi facilities, but the classrooms are well maintained and the labs are also considered to be good. It has a separate library with a lot of books available for student reference. The hostel is not properly maintained and the food quality is awful. Most of the hostellers eat canteen food but that too is average. The college has some basic medical facilities and does not give much importance to sports.

reviews.review_heading: We achieved enviable placement records in 2022 with 1150+offers.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure was good. The hostel for boys and girls was well furnished and sophisticated. The food was provided was good. Artificial Intelligence combines artificial intelligence and machines learning solutions to develop and deploy reliable and scalable data solutions.

reviews.review_heading: Our college has good placements and academics but not satisfied with the infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: From the third year, we can avail of placements from 3rd year and guidance to crack the exams. Around 30 companies visit our college for recruitment. Training is given by reputed companies for placements. We usually have 3 months of training for aptitude and communication skills. As it is an autonomous college, we have a separate syllabus for aptitude every semester.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: It is extremely good for students who are free-minded. There is no bullying.

content.Placements: The level of placement is moderate. In this government college, we have to find internships by ourselves, as it does not offer any paid internships. Placements are okay. 70 percent of students get placements, and others just go and prepare for master's.
content.Infrastructure: It is a government college, but believe me, facilities are insane. It has a center AC. Classrooms have smart boards and have a good environment. We have our own app for attendance. The attendance only fills if we apply via the college app, or else we do not get a present mark.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely worth the time and money with all the industry-ready tools to make us succeed.

content.Placements: The major roles which are offered in our senior batch are in finance and marketing. Almost 90% batch is being placed, and the placement drive process is still ongoing. 100% of the batch for the internships with an average stipend of Rs 20,000. Top recruiter is Federal Bank. The average package is around 7 LPA, and 16 LPA is the highest.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure with that amount of fee is extraordinary. It has a top-notch library with all the publications needed and required to be studied. We have Wi-Fi on campus and a ground to play. Infrastructure is no less than an understatement.

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Applied Chemistry - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: A Best college to study.

content.Placements: Each year more than 60% students get directly placed from campus placement, and the rest also get their job with the help of placement cell and the department. The placement cell is getting wider day by day. The role of placement cell is very crucial and good for the students of M.Sc. Applied Chemistry. Also, this placement cell not only works for one department; in MS University, there are respective placement cells in each faculty, so no need to worry just maintain a good academic record and the rest will be good.
content.Infrastructure: Awesome building and facilities at laboratory and library. Overall, a good building and a good environment. Free Wi-Fi placement for all students with secure privacy and proxy network. Everyone has their unique username and password for Wi-Fi login. The parking facility in the faculty is also good.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Filled with technology and discipline.

content.Placements: 80% of board exam students are placed in B.Com Course. The highest package offered is 12LPA, and the lowest package offered is 6LPA, provided in our course. Top requirements for companies like Reliance, Tata, Adani, etc. Top roles like Manager, Accountant, etc., 50% students get a placement.
content.Infrastructure: On our campus, they provide many facilities like a computer lab, a Physics lab, toilets, a washroom, clean classrooms, and hostel facilities. In our campus, there is a cricket ground, and many other sports facilities are provided to encourage the students.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. in Shastri (Jyotishshastra) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: College is very average.

content.Placements: No students get direct placement from this college of MSU Baroda. No packages available for students in the Maharaja Shivajirao University of Baroda. Companies cannot visit because college do not allow them.
content.Infrastructure: There is a basic infrastructure in the college. There is only classroom and principal's hobbies at this college, not other facilities like a Wi-Fi, labs, and library.
content.Faculty: Teachers have a very basic knowledge of the course, and no one can be directly helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable about that teaching quality. Students are not interested in attending the regular classes because of the teachers.

faqs.question: How can I get admission in MJPRU Bareilly?
faqs.answer: MJPRU Bareilly admissions are both merit and entrance-based for respective UG and PG courses. For a few UG courses such as BA, BSc, BCom, etc., admissions are offered based on candidates' merit scores obtained in their last qualifying exam. Further, to get admission to courses such as LLB, MEd, MSc, etc., candidates have to qualify for the university-level entrance exam. For other UG and PG courses, Rohilkhand University accepts a valid scores of CUET UG and CUET PG entrance exams. Later on, the selected students are allocated seats via a counselling process. Read more about the detailed MJPRU admission process 2023,here.

faqs.question: Can I take direct admission at MJPRU?
faqs.answer: MJPRU admissions are either entrance or merit-based. Candidates have to qualify for the minimum eligibility criteria to apply for any of the UG & PG courses. For PG courses, MJPRU conducts the MJPRU entrance exam. Apart from that for courses such as BPharm, BTech, MBA, MCA, etc., the university accepts valid scores of JEE Main, CUET UG & CUET PG entrance exams. Further, for other UG courses, admissions are entirely based on the merit obtained in the previous qualifying exam.

faqs.question: Is JEE exam necessary to take admission to B Tech in MJPRU, Bareilly?
faqs.answer: Yes, for BTech admissions at MJPRU, Bareilly, candidates need to clearJEE Mainexam. Moreover, for BTech (Lateral Entry) course, students need to qualifyCUET UG. Also, candidates need to fulfil the eligibility criteroa for admissions. The eligibility criteria for admissions at Mahatma Jyotiba Phule Rohilkhand University (MJPRU), Bareilly for BTech course is that candidate should have been passed Class 12 with a minimum of 45% aggregate.

faqs.question: Can I do LLM in MJPRU without taking an entrance test?
faqs.answer: No,MJPRU LLM admissionsare purely entry-based. Thus, students seeking admission to this programme must register and appear for theentrance test conducted by the university.The test runs for 1.5 hours and tests students on their knowledge of the law field. paragraphs: According to Mahatma Jyotiba Phule Rohilkhand University Engineering NIRF report 2025, 267 BTech students were placed and 31 students were selected for higher studies out of 307 graduating students in 2024 . BTech median package recorded during MJPRU placements 2024 was 9.2 LPA .

faqs.question: What career prospects can I expect after completing LLM from MJPRU?
faqs.answer: An LLM degree from MJPRU opens the doors to various job opportunities. Upon completing their degree, students can apply for job titles such as Corporate Litigation Attorney, Corporate Lawyer, Legal Associate, and more. The starting salary offered to students with good academic backgrounds ranges from INR 6 Lacs to INR 7 lakh. However, the pay and job title may differ from student to student depending on the student's skill, knowledge, and experience.

Manav Rachna University offers BTech and MBA programmes to students as its flagship programmes. placements.overview:
Manav Rachna University is a private university and is located in Faridabad. Earlier, in 2004, it was known as the Manav Rachna College of Engineering (MRCE), that later got evolved into Manav Rachna University (MRU) in 2014. It is a UGC-recognised university and has been accredited by the NAAC with an A grade. All the Technical programmes offered by the university are approved by the AICTE. Manav Rachna University comprises more than 5 schools that offer various UG, PG, and PhD programmes in the fields of Law, Management, Technology, Sciences, and others.

The university has been ranked in the band of 201-300 by the NIRF 2025 in the BTech category. It has also ranked 51 by the India Today 2025 in the BBA category. Manav Rachna University courses are offered to students at the UG and PG levels, mainly in Engineering, Management, Science, Law, and Computer Application streams. Some of the popular courses offered by the university are , BBA, BSc, , MBA, and MTech.

Manav Rachna University admissions are open for the year 2026. The university provides a wide range of programmes to students at the UG and PG levels. Some of the popular courses offered at the university are BTech, BSc, BBA, MBA, MTech, etc. Manav Rachna University course admission is both merit and entrance-based. The university conducts its entrance exam by the name of Manav Rachna National Aptitude Test (MRNAT) for providing admission to various courses.

review_summary.college_name: Manav Rachna University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: I am satisfied because of the good faculty, helping mentors, and extracurricular activities.

content.Placements: 70% of students get placed on campus placements and others go off-campus placements. The highest package ranges from 14-20 LPA. The lowest package is 4 LPA, but it can vary. Companies like Thoughtworks, LTIMindtree, HCL, etc., hire students. 30-40% of students get internships in companies like National Instruments, etc. Software developer roles are preferred here.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available. Labs and libraries are pretty good. There are many libraries inside the campus only where students can study. It is decent. The food is good and healthy and as a college student, it is satisfying. Medical facilities are available on the campus. Sports tournaments are also conducted.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) in Association with Xebia - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Overall, it is a fine college, but I would recommend that there are better colleges with same fees.

content.Placements: Till date, the highest package is 60 LPA from the 2023 batch. The average is somewhere around 5-6 LPA, but that too if you are good at what you want to do. Placement is decent, not too bad, but there are better options than this college if I have to be brutally honest.
content.Infrastructure: If I have to talk about classrooms, they are decently okay. There are all the basic facilities in a class, like Wi-Fi, etc. But if we talk about hostels, they aren't worth the amount you are spending. Rooms are just fine, but toilets are barely usable. The Wi-Fi in the hostel isn't the best and barely functions. Now, if we talk about the mess, the food served here is mostly just trash. The laundry service gives you clothes almost a week later, and sometimes clothes aren't washed properly.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Satisfied with the faculty members and they are very helpful.

content.Placements: The highest salary package offered in the previous year was 55 LPA, and the lowest salary package offered was 2 LPA. Many companies like TCS, Dyson, etc., visit the college for placements. Many students got unpaid internships and many students got paid internships as they vary by student.
content.Infrastructure: I am not a hostel student, but my friend told me that is nice but not so good. Our college provides Wi-Fi, classrooms, clean labs, and proper computer setup. The library is full of books, either knowledgeable, funny or modern technology in sports. There are many clubs at the college and university levels.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Manav Rachna University is a university one should join to enjoy campus life.

content.Placements: I don't remember the exact amount but around 80% of students got placement in my course. As we all know the packages vary according to our knowledge. The highest salary package offered is 18 LPA. The average salary package offered ranges from 4 LPA - 5 LPA and the lowest salary package offered is 3.5 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: They provide good facilities like a gaming zone (indoor games), outdoor games, and good Wi-Fi speed throughout the campus. Libraries and classrooms are also good. And yes you will love our food courts.
content.Faculty: To join a college, faculty members play an important role. I can say that our faculty members are very supportive and of good nature. Students can easily build a good bond with them. They are also highly qualified and teaching quality is good. This course will properly make you industry-ready. Exams are quite tough so be ready.

individual_reviews.course: BBA in Business Analytics in collaboration with ISDC - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Good college, value for money.

content.Placements: 20 percent were placed. I don't know the highest and the lowest package offered by HR, and I don't know about the packages of the students as I was not in touch with the friends and faculty for a long time. But yes, it was average as I know till now.
content.Infrastructure: Good amenities provided by the college, and the infrastructure was also very nice. The canteen was very good as there were 3 places to eat with different options. A Nescafé and a Subway were also there to chill and have food with friends and spend time.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied because of the good faculty, helping mentors, and extracurricular activities.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available. Labs and libraries are pretty good. There are many libraries inside the campus only where students can study. It is decent. The food is good and healthy and as a college student, it is satisfying. Medical facilities are available on the campus. Sports tournaments are also conducted.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, it is a fine college, but I would recommend that there are better colleges with same fees.
reviews.review_text: If I have to talk about classrooms, they are decently okay. There are all the basic facilities in a class, like Wi-Fi, etc. But if we talk about hostels, they aren't worth the amount you are spending. Rooms are just fine, but toilets are barely usable. The Wi-Fi in the hostel isn't the best and barely functions. Now, if we talk about the mess, the food served here is mostly just trash. The laundry service gives you clothes almost a week later, and sometimes clothes aren't washed properly.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the faculty members and they are very helpful.
reviews.review_text: I am not a hostel student, but my friend told me that is nice but not so good. Our college provides Wi-Fi, classrooms, clean labs, and proper computer setup. The library is full of books, either knowledgeable, funny or modern technology in sports. There are many clubs at the college and university levels.

reviews.review_heading: Manav Rachna University is a university one should join to enjoy campus life.
reviews.review_text: They provide good facilities like a gaming zone (indoor games), outdoor games, and good Wi-Fi speed throughout the campus. Libraries and classrooms are also good. And yes you will love our food courts.

reviews.review_heading: Good college, value for money.
reviews.review_text: Good amenities provided by the college, and the infrastructure was also very nice. The canteen was very good as there were 3 places to eat with different options. A Nescafé and a Subway were also there to chill and have food with friends and spend time.

reviews.review_heading: If your home is near MRU you can definitely take admission.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of my college is very good and well maintained. The college provides excellent facilities, including Wi-Fi, labs, and three libraries, each with a different purpose. The library is quiet, and students can study there from 8 am to 4 pm. The entire college is air conditioned. For sports, we have a basketball court, a cricket ground, a football ground, and an indoor sports arena. All the playing grounds and equipment are well maintained. The canteen food is very good, but a bit e...

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with the college till now.
reviews.review_text: Good facilities and infrastructure are provided by Manav Rachna University. They have 4 libraries, 2 auditoriums and many rooms for workshops. It contains many lectures and tutorial rooms. All rooms are well equipped with ACs. There is Wi-Fi facility all over the campus. Hostels are also well maintained. Food at the mess and canteen is good. Well-developed medical facilities and sports arenas are there.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, I am satisfied with my college, and I love being in it.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good, but the labs are not well-equipped with computers. Some of the computers do not work, and Wi-Fi sometimes creates issues. The quality of facilities in my hostel and the quality of food everywhere in the mess are not that good compared to other colleges, and I think my college is good in sports and games.

reviews.review_heading: Manav Rachna University? Maybe think again!
reviews.review_text: There are 2 libraries and both the libraries have an e-library access. Every classroom has AC installed which keeps the classrooms cool during the summers. There is a college wifi available which is only accessible to the hostelers. The hostel food has degraded and is not satisfactory as per the heavy fees charged.

reviews.review_heading: Good private college for engineering .
reviews.review_text: Manav Rachna provides good facilities and has a great infrastructure. The whole campus has a Wi-Fi network and there are numerous labs for different subjects. The classrooms were equipped with ACs and also had three libraries, a sports arena, and two medical rooms.

reviews.review_heading: My Review With My Experience .
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is amazing. There is campus-wide free Wi-Fi support for students. There are around 15 labs in the college, including computer labs, chemistry labs, etc. There are about 4 libraries in the college. The medical facility is very good; the doctor is available on Wednesday and Friday at no cost. There are many sports facilities in the college.

reviews.review_heading: Moderately satisfied because of environment .
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are fully air conditioned and smart class with projector in each class. Students have also access to Wi-Fi labs are also well designed there are indoor and outdoor sports both and equipments for both are available There are 3 libraries in campus, and one is the biggest in Faridabad .

reviews.review_heading: Overview of Manav Rachna University.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is so good and well maintained, it is based on greenery and the building looks is like a flagship. There are too many departments like Engineering, Law, Science, BBA, MBA, etc. My department is so good because in the IT field, there is a boom in the market and the course focuses on it. The hostel is too expensive and the quality of food is good. There is a sports arena where you play many games. There is collaboration with Sarvodhya in terms of medical facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Great college with great infrastructure .
reviews.review_text: The hostel here is pretty great and has decent-quality food. We are provided with free Wi-Fi, laundry, library, gym, sports arena, etc. The hostel looks after the health and hygiene of the students and the food quality is average. Overall, I would say the hostel is good.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, it is a good university.
reviews.review_text: Good infrastructure. It is very well maintained and it is situated in the Aravalli Hills. contains a park and sports arena. They gave their volleyball and cricket teams, which play in tournaments like district or state. There is Wi-Fi enabled all over the campus.

They can get admission by acquiring minimum of 45% aggregate in Class 12.

individual_reviews.course: B.Des. in Product Design - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: A very good, well-rounded experience.

content.Placements: I don't really know the exact number, but all the students who do really well in classes, exams, and assignments get very good packages. The college trains you from the first year to attend interviews, showcase your work, and market yourself in the form of juries. Major companies and industry experts even come to review and give feedback on your portfolio before placements begin. It's all on you again, but if you put in the effort, you succeed.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is very good. Hostel rooms have separate washrooms, and the food in the mess is excellent with quite a lot of variety. The hostel keeps strict records of every student who goes in and out. You need permission from multiple people to go home or spend the night outside. Very safe. The in-time is usually 9 in the first year and extends in later years.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely satisfied with placements and facilities.

content.Placements: Placements are very good. According to the previous year more than 75 percent of students got placed. There are a lot of big companies like Nykaa, Myntra, etc. coming to SOC. There are a lot of students from SOC who are serving as engineers in big companies.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure of our college is the best. We have separate classes for every division. There are computer labs with good internet. Library is also nice, we can also borrowbooks for a few days. The hostel is equipped with Wi-Fi and water coolers and all the floors have separate Wi-Fi with good speed.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Food Technology - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: The college is good, but the food technology department is not very good.

content.Placements: No roles are offered. There are no placements. Students are talented but due to lack of opportunities, they fall short. Not even 1% of students get placed. It is totally bad. If good service had been provided, then things would have been totally different. Moreover, the principal poor management skills.
content.Infrastructure: Hostels are good. The infrastructure is really great. Facilities are amazing. The hostel life is exactly how it should be. The food is bad, but I would recommend students to move out to a flat after the 2nd year because it is not good for too long, and that is a fact about every kind of hostel.

review_summary.college_name: MLR Institute of Technology Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Information Technology - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Good college that supports extracurricular activities.

content.Placements: The company called Catalog offered the highest package of around 25 LPA. Only one 1 member got selected, and that too from our department. The second highest is around 12 LPA-18 LPA. There are a few companies, like Microsoft, DBS, and a few others, that offer internships.
content.Infrastructure: Compared to any 2-tier or 3-tier colleges, MLRIT provides the best infrastructure and maintenance of classrooms, labs, etc. The food that is available in the canteen is a bit expensive for the taste and quality they provide. Coffee and hot chocolate are mostly preferred by my friends.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Data Science) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Super campus life with full of enjoyable events.

content.Placements: In our college training and placements block, there is a block where we get knowledge on the written test of the companies, and Rs. 15,000 is paid for the training and placements. Companies like Cognizant, Infosys, and HCL Tech come to our college. In our college, 40 percent of the students are placed, and the rest of the students are searching for jobs, and some have gone on to higher studies.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college is average, and classrooms are well-equipped, and Wi-fi is provided throughout the campus. We can use the Wi-Fi, and libraries are also well-equipped, but the maintenance of the classrooms and labs is average, not up to the mark. The environment of the college is very good with greenery. Besides our college, Arundhati Institute is there, where we can get all the medical facilities.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Average tier 2 college, we can't expect everyone to be fun and knowledgeable it's a mid college.

content.Placements: The average salary is 4 LPA so we can't expect much from college. They take us through placement training but that won't be of any help for sure. We come to this college just to do time pass but we can improve our skills by joining clubs and stuff.
content.Infrastructure: It's pretty decent not too high nor too low but it's decent. For what we are paying, it's a little low. But the infrastructure is not that bad when compared to the management and faculty. This college portrays itself as the best while it's not in real.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Good infrastructure, above-average faculty, and good events.

content.Placements: Basically, the strength of students in my particular branch/course is very low, so placements are average, so we can assume 3/10 students get placed in good companies like Infosys, TCS, and other top companies. But most students go with the Master's option.
content.Infrastructure: Good Wi-Fi, good classrooms, and very good infrastructure facilities, the computers work very well. The canteen and other food stalls are very well maintained. Gives good importance to sports. Labs are maintained very well all the equipment works perfectly.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Data Science) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely satisfied with college environment.

content.Placements: Placements in college are excellent for the ongoing batch. The highest package is about 8 LPA - 10 LPA, where the lowest package is about 2.5 LPA - 3 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Cognizant, HCL Tech, Infosys, Capgemini, etc. Almost 70 percent of the students are placed.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure are good. We have a spacious library, and sports places where we can also concentrate on the sports. Classrooms are spacious with a projector. Hostel facility is provided in the premises with quality food and security.

reviews.review_heading: College gives knowledge and good friends while others do not provide this environment.

reviews.review_heading: Enjoyable events and academics in our college.

reviews.review_heading: Super placements college.

reviews.review_heading: It is an overhyped college. I would not recommend this college.

reviews.review_heading: I absolutely enjoyed the campus life and the atmosphere in the college.

admission_process.title: NIT- Narula Institute of Technology Admission

paragraphs: NIT- Narula Institute of Technology admissionto all courses is entrance-based. The institute accepts various national/ state-level entrance exams such as JEE Main, WBJEE, CET, etc., to shortlist candidates for admission. The Institute offers undergraduate, postgraduate, and diploma courses in the fields of Engineering and Technology,Computer applications,commerceandmanagement. To apply forNIT Kolkata course admission, candidates must fill out the online application form available on the official website of the institute.

The admission criteria for NIT Kolkata coursesis entrance-based. However, candidates must meet the course-specific eligibility criteria to apply for the courses. Interested candidates can check out the table below forNIT Kolkata courses eligibility and selection criteria:

NIT Kolkatahas a multi-step admission process which students need to follow to get into the college. Starting with the application, students are required to go through the course-specific entrance exam. After the selection rounds are over, course-wise merit lists are released on the official website of the university/college post which interested candidates can submit the fee and confirm their admission. Candidates must check the eligibility criteria on the official website of NIT Kolkata, before filling out the admission form.

Students seeking admission to NIT Kolkata must submit the online application form for all UG and PG courses, as per their preferred course. The application process is completely conducted in online mode.
Step 2: Selection Criteria 2024 & Release of Merit List

After the applications are submitted, students are required to go through the course-specific entrance exam. After the selection rounds are over, course-wise merit lists are released on the official website of the institute.
Post the selection rounds, candidates who are shortlisted and have their names on the merit lists can submit the fee and confirm their admission to the relevant course at NIT Kolkata.

reviews.review_heading: Narula Institute of Technology, the college you can't regret.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good. Not upto the mark but by far I'll say good. Small campus and things, you'll feel like you're still in school. Food quality is decent. Also, there's a cafeteria and canteen so you get food for really cheap and there are cafes too in front of the college so you will not face any problem. The hostel is outside the campus because the campus is very small like 5 acres.

reviews.review_heading: College is overall good for engineering.
reviews.review_text: All things of the course are good, classrooms, washrooms, labs, and library are very well maintained, Wi-Fi is provided, the campus is not very big but enjoyable, many events happen every year, and the hostel is average, enough for a student to stay and study.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied because of the infrastructure, faculty and events.
reviews.review_text: We have a huge library with thousands of books and free Wi-Fi. We have labs for all B.Tech courses. The building is air-conditioned. Food quality in the canteen and hostel is above average, with good, affordable prices. Medical facilities are good. The college is very much involved in events, sports and games.

reviews.review_heading: If students are preparing for competitive exams, then I suggest taking admission to this college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is quite good, and labs are quite equipped. Hostel wardens are too bad. They are not giving the food to other state students. They are misbehaving with students. The canteen food is too good and at a low price. Canteen members are behaving very well with everyone.

reviews.review_heading: This is a very good college, and the campus life is enjoyable.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is excellent. The library and book issue process are very easy. The library has MacBooks and labs for Mechanical Engineering. Many departments, including Electrical, Management, Computer, and other Engineering departments, are well-equipped. The college overall is good. Classrooms are modern and the rooms are well-equipped with air conditioning. Every classroom is AC and has tables and modular furniture. The college has a very nice campus life to enjoy.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Narula Institute of Technology. It is excellent.
reviews.review_text: Our college has a great campus. Labs have all the required equipment. Classrooms are very clean. The environment in our college is very student-friendly. The college hostel is clean and well-managed. Canteen food is delicious, and we have an NCC unit in our college. We have football and cricket teams, and basketball, badminton, and chess are also popular among students.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college. Teachers are good. But if you love CS then it's good.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi doesn't work anytime. Labs, classroom, and library are too good. Overall, you can feel good here. I think if someone doesn't ask you donation, then it's the best college. I think you can consider it as a future college.

reviews.review_heading: This is the best college to take admission in, as the facilities are very good.
reviews.review_text: The labs are awesome and well-maintained, and the campus has Wi-Fi. The classrooms are modern and well-organized, and they have an LCD panel. The library is very clean and awesome, and you can borrow books from it at any time. The hostel quality is also good, though the food in the hostel is average. The college has medical facilities and offers all types of sports, in addition to some indoor games.

reviews.review_heading: Narula Institute of Technology is a very good private institute.
reviews.review_text: The college provides free Wi-Fi and a clean environment. Classes are good, and they teach on a blackboard. Labs are good and air-conditioned. There is a library too, where you can take books for up to 1 month. The college has a playground where many play football.

reviews.review_heading: It's a nice college for studying and getting a placement.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides nice hostels. Many features are available for cooling water and no rain. Many more extra features are available. Classes are good but I play more than 6 lakhs. We have no AC room for study. The library is not good, no AC available. It's crowded and not good.

reviews.review_heading: Reality of BCA in Narula Institute of Technology(NIT).
reviews.review_text: College has decent infrastructure for its students. Although the thing that I hate the most is that there is no AC in most of the classrooms. Only the computer labs have AC. Wi-Fi is available throughout the campus, though the range is weak in some areas of the college. There are dedicated Wi-Fi rooms, so internet-related work won't be a hassle. Library has a lot of books, so you can read quietly in library. But again, the library has no AC, so it gets hot in the summer. Hostel is decent.

reviews.review_heading: Considering this college is not bad.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is not bad. The outside appearance is good, but the interior facilities of the classrooms and labs are not good. AC, Wi-Fi, and smart boards are also limited. The library contains various books related to academics. Hostel facilities are the same as those of other colleges; the food is manageable. Getting exposure in sports is very hard since the college doesn't have playgrounds.

reviews.review_heading: A brief review of Narula Institute of Technology & one of the best private colleges in West Bengal.
reviews.review_text: Our college has decent infrastructure compared to other government colleges in West Bengal. However, there are a few problems. There is no AC in classrooms or labs (except the computer labs), so it gets hot in the summer. The ground is quite small, barely enough to host one sporting event. All labs have equipment, but some of the apparatus is old. The college looks good from the inside, especially the ground floor, but the lack of AC is a big issue during the summer. The hostel has very limited ...

reviews.review_heading: Great college to start you career with.
reviews.review_text: For our department, there are dedicated Wi-Fi routers, labs are used by many other departments (shared labs). There is a dedicated classroom for our department but it changes every semester. There is also a library with a collection of more than 11000 books and a public room for reading. Hostel infrastructure is average (do not expect much), the food is decent (chicken is on Sunday), and after 10:00 PM the gate of the hostel closes. Medical facilities are there. Sports are conducted in college g...

reviews.review_heading: Affordable and decent college with good teachers, stable placements, and growing infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available across campus. Classrooms and labs are decent, though labs could be better equipped. Library is useful with enough resources. Hostels are okay, basic but livable. Mess food is average but hygienic. Medical help is available. Sports and common areas are accessible and regularly used.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: College is good, only the campus is small, and all other facilities are also good.

content.Placements: 45% percent of my computer engineering branch is placed till now, with the average package of 7 LPA, and placement is still going. The highest package is 10 LPA PPO, the lowest package is 5.8 LPA, and the average package is 7 LPA. The top recruiting companies are Trinamix, JSW, and Cognizant, which will also come soon. Students have to get an internship on their own.
content.Infrastructure: All facilities and infrastructure are the best. But the quality of food available in the mess is, as you know, average quality. All other medical facilities, sports, and games are best provided here. You also get a medical card, which you can use in any verified hospital for treatment.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: The college is really old and authentic. According to fees, the college provides enough.

content.Placements: For mechanical engineering placement is quite authentic. The highest package ranges from 15 LPA for our seniors, and the average is 6-7 LPA. Students usually get good internships and good placements. SIH is also held, and if used properly, a lot of opportunities are provided.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms and labs are well-maintained. Wi-Fi is provided in hostels and everywhere. The library is really big. Ground for sports is provided. The hostel for girls is quite big with mostly double shared rooms and a few triple rooms. Food in the mess is average. As you will be in a hostel, you need to adjust here.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: College is good. It is value for money but some further improvements are needed.

content.Placements: The top branch of this college is metallurgy and mechanical. In 2025, almost all students get placed and the average for metallurgy is approximately 9LPA and for mechanical is 6 to 7 LPA. The placement of 2026 is ongoing, some students of computer engineering get full time offer, metallurgy and mechanical are going decently.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is old but some buildings are new. There is a computer lab, classrooms are decent but AC is not available in classroom, and a library is there beside the red building where almost all books are available. There is two seater room for the 1st year. One table, one chair and a bed provided by the hostel authority. Mess food is good. It is value for money.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: NIAMT Ranchi has strong academics with scope for modernization.

content.Placements: The placements are good around 8 to 10 LPA for a above average student, but if you maintain a good CGPA and if you do perform well in a technical club like a racing club for mechanical engineering it improves your placement percentage, and mainly you should not have any backlog.
content.Infrastructure: College has a fully residential green campus with a well equipped academic block and modern manufacturing labs and workshops. A central library, computer center with Wi-Fi, separate boys and girls hostels, sports facilities, gym only after the first sem, medical center, and basic campus amenities.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Absolute college for return on investment.

content.Placements: More than 95% of students of my branch (mechanical engineering) got placed with an average package of 9 LPA and the highest package of 13.95 LPA. The top recruiting companies that come here for placement are JSW, Vedanta, Maruti Suzuki, Tata, Anand Group, L&T, Pradeep Metalliks, NowPurchase, Future First, etc.
content.Infrastructure: A 67-acre green campus with a library that consists of more than 50000 books, a centralized computer room, a gym, a cafeteria owned by KitKat, a lush green football and cricket ground on campus, Wi-Fi campus, a lecture hall complex for all classes, and for each year, there is a separate hostel. From the 2nd year, single rooms are allotted.

The top recruiters of the National Institute of Advanced Manufacturing Technology in 2024 included KPMG, Mahindra, JSW Group, Sona Comstar, LUMIVO, Reliance, ISGEC Heavy Engineering, Tata Steel, etc.

Earlier, the highest and average packages offered to BTech students during the National Institute of Advanced Manufacturing Technology placements 2023 were INR 14 LPA and INR 9.25 LPA, respectively. faqs.question: How can I get admission to NIT Andhra Pradesh?
faqs.answer: The admission is entrance-based in most of the NIT Andhra Pradesh courses. It accepts JEE Main scores for BTech and GATE score for MTech admissions. faqs.question: Is JEE Main required for admission to NIT Andhra Pradesh?
faqs.answer: NIT Andhra Pradesh admission to BTech courses are conducted through JEE Main. The Admission to different courses is conducted by national-level entrance tests likeJEE Main,GATE, and so on. Final seat distribution is carried out viaCCMN,CCMT, and other counselling sessions. Only JEE Main results are accepted by NIT Andhra Pradesh for admission to its BTech programme. As a result, individuals can apply to NIT Andhra Pradesh for admission to a variety of programs, except for BTech, without taking the JEE Mains.

reviews.review_heading: Campus infrastructure is very good. Hostels and mess are best.
reviews.review_text: Lab is good. Modern facilities are available. Hostel rooms are 4-seaters. There are 3 fans with full light. Mess is good, and canteen is available 6 days and Sunday is off. Medical facilities are available 24X7, and sports are good. College is free upto one lakh medical treatment for one year. Students are 1st priorities for system. Almost 30 clubs are available, and library is very good. Student life is perfect.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely, a very good college for placements.
reviews.review_text: Our department has a good computer lab, spacious classrooms, and a library with enough books for study. The campus is also very neat and well-maintained. Classrooms have a projector for teaching, smart boards, and green boards. Labs have a required system for software.

reviews.review_heading: This college is best for your future build-up.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is excellent for computer science programming, with numerous computer systems provided and well-known technicians available. Wi-Fi is accessible, and classrooms are digital. The library is fully air-conditioned and has a wide selection of books. The quality of food in the mess is very good. The medical facility is available for students with a van who take it to drop at the door.

reviews.review_heading: Review of NIT Andhra Pradesh - National Institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text: There are large classrooms which are capable of fitting 90-100 students at a time. Classrooms are fitted with smart TVs, blackboards, and whiteboards. It provides various laboratories for work. Hostels are very neat and new. Wi-Fi is available in the hostel with good connectivity. The food is hygienic, healthy, and tasty. A 24x7 medical facility is available. A various number of grounds are available for sports. A canteen is also there on the campus.

reviews.review_heading: Review of NIT Andhra Pradesh - National Institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text: The library is very nice and new. It contains all books, different publications, and newspapers. The Wi-Fi connection is extraordinary. The quality of the food is above average. The canteen food is good and somewhat expensive. The hygiene is good. Sports and games tournaments are conducted in different NITs every year. Mother Theresa Health Center is available at the college, but all facilities are not provided.

reviews.review_heading: It has a good infrastructure and is value for money.
reviews.review_text: For every course, there will be a smart board in the class, so that faculty members can explain things easily. There are a total of 10 labs in our department. For every semester, students have to perform two labs. In the library, there is a separate section for our course and also for others. Wi-Fi is provided in the library. The menu of mess is good. The quality of the food is not bad. In hostels, there are many facilities like geysers, free Wi-Fi, tables and chairs but there is no washing mach...

reviews.review_heading: It has a nice campus, and it will be more beautiful in the upcoming years.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very nice. There are two laboratories on campus. Electrical engineering labs have almost all the equipment. There is AC in the lab, and it also has a good network connection. Some classrooms do not have AC, but the remaining classrooms have AC. There is a good network connection in both the hostels and classrooms. There is one library which is full of books. We can issue books through registration or by machines. The taste of the food in the canteen is very nice. Mess food ...

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with the college.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facilities are good. There is Wi-Fi facility in hostel. All the hostel rooms and washrooms are cleaned daily. Hostels are maintained neat. College also has indoor and outdoor sports facilities and a gym. Hostel food is average, sometimes good sometimes average. There is also a separate block for medical facilities. All the staff are friendly in manner.

reviews.review_heading: Real and Raw Review of NIT Andhra Pradesh.
reviews.review_text: Hostels are well-maintained, but the Wi-Fi here is not so good; it stops working quite a few times. The classrooms are well-equipped with air conditioning, as the temperature here is too high in summer. Talking about the mess, food is good on some days, but on most days, it is below average. For studying and books, the BR Ambedkar Library is open from 9 AM to 12 AM. Medical facilities are provided in Mother Teresa Hospital. Sports facilities are good. A cricket stadium, badminton court, basketba...

reviews.review_heading: It is a good NIT for students who want to pursue B.Tech.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very good, but it is under construction as many areas of the college are vacant. The college head made some desire building which is helpful for us. A lot of facilities are provided by the hostel authority, like a cooler, lift, washing machines, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely dissatisfied with placements in 2024, but it has decent infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Decent infrastructure and facilities when compared with other colleges. As it was a newly established institute, we have decent infrastructure, with new hostel blocks when compared with other institutes. The quality of food available in the mess is not so good, but it was okay.

reviews.review_heading: The review of NIT Andhra Pradesh.
reviews.review_text: The hostels are very neat and they maintain the hostels very properly and they provide Wi-Fi in the hostel and the classes are very small and they provide many sports facilities like inter NIT sports and the canteen called Dokka Settama will be there in the college.

reviews.review_heading: New college and good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available to us are excellent. Since the college is newly constructed, the construction is up-to-date and gives a good vibe. Classrooms and the library are up to the mark, with all the facilities like smart boards in classrooms, AC in the library, etc. Wi-Fi is also decent. The quality of the facilities at the hostel is above average, but the food available in the mess is below average. There is a medical center and a gymnasium. Outdoor and indoor sports complex...

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely disappointed with the placements in 2024, and no proper director is the greatest flaw.
reviews.review_text: Hostels are good, and maintenance is very good. Mess food will be better; you have to adjust for it. Canteen food tastes good, but the quantity for the amount is very less. Medical facilities are good enough, and sports and games are conducted actively. However, most games cannot be seen by most of them as they are conducted during lecture times.

reviews.review_heading: If you want to save your future, then please avoid this college.
reviews.review_text: In the mess, it is impossible to find hygienic and edible food. Students eat in the mess just because the canteen in this college is more expensive than a restaurant. Every year, the same people get contracts through corruption. I think the situation of Wi-Fi and network in the jungle is better than this college. Every semester, students pay extra fees but get nothing from the institute.
