admission_overview.title: PCCOE Admission Overview 2025
admission_overview.description: PCCOE admissions are based on entrance-exam scores of the candidates. The college consides scores in JEE Main, MHT CET, MAH MCA CET, etc. for admission to specific programmes. Pimpri Chinchwad College of Engineering offers seats to candidates through CAP or Common Admission Process conducted by State Common Entrance Test Cell, Government of Maharashtra. The college offers courses at UG and PG levels in Engineering and Computer Applications streams in affiliation with SPPU. Interested candidates can apply for the accepted entrance test and participate in counselling process for a seat in the college.

eligibility_selection.title: PCCOE Eligibility & Selection 2025
eligibility_selection.description: PCCOE offers admissions to candidates based on their national or state-level entrance exam scores. Admission to the flagship course i.e. BTech is through MHT CET or JEE Main scores. Besides, aspirants should also fulfill the eligibility requirements to apply for admission. Below are PCCOE courses along with their eligibility and selection criteria:

courses_table.eligibility: Class 12 or its equivalent examination with Physics and Mathematics as compulsory subjects along with Chemistry or Biotechnology or Biology or Technical vocational subject or Computer Science of Information Technology or Informatics Practices or Agriculture or Engineering Graphics or Business Studies or Electronics or Entrepreneurship with at least 45% aggregate (40% aggregate for reserved category, EWS and Person with Disability candidates belonging to Maharashtra)

admission_process.title: PCCOE Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: PCCOE admission processhas appearing for entrance exam, participating in counselling rounds, filling out institute-level application form and reporting at the campus. Students who are interested in taking admission in any of the given programmes need to apply and appear for the accepted entrance test. Below are the guidelines to get a seat in PCCOE:

Students have to first apply for MHT CET or JEE Main for BTech, MHTCET MTech or GATE for MTech and MAH MCA CET for MCA programmes. Once the results are out, passing candidates can fill out the CAP Counselling form.

Aspirants have to participate in CAP Counselling for seat allotment. Candidates are offered seat based on their rank in the entrance test. MHT CET or JEE Main for BTech, MAH MCA CET for MCA and MHTCET MTech/ GATE for MTech is considered for admission.

Those who are offered seat are then required to fill out the admission form available on the college's website. After submission of the form, aspirants need to report at the campus for document verification. Further, candidates also need to pay thePCCOE feeto confirm their seat. reviews.review_heading: Students may prefer to choose the college blindly, as the college is known for its placements.
reviews.review_text: Boys hostel is newly built, and it is of super quality with AC rooms. It has very clean and hygienic mess services. The college provides various facilities like a sports complex, gymnasium, two big playgrounds, and an art circle team. Classrooms and labs are fully digitalised.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and sports facilities are available.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very good. We have all the facilities that are required for our course. We also have labs specially for electronics. The hostels of our college are very posh. There is regular cleaning of our room by workers. The food is average.

reviews.review_heading: Academics with proper health.

reviews.review_heading: Not a bad college. They focus more on technical knowledge, a strict college, and good infrastructure

reviews.review_heading: Pimpri Chinchwad College of Engineering, Pune, Maharashtra.

classrooms are nice

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: Review of School of Engineering, Presidency University, Bangalore.

review_content.Placements: About 60 percent of students get placed. The highest package offered is 13.5 LPA, and the lowest package offered is 3.75 LPA. The average package offered is 4.5 LPA. Many students are eligible to get jobs in the campus placements themselves. There is an international cell which helps students who want to study a Master's abroad.
review_content.Infrastructure: Our college has a good infrastructure with air-conditioned labs. It has very good hostels with very big and vast rooms. It has the Sodexo food company, which maintains neat, hygienic, and good food. This college has a very good van facility that runs all over Bengaluru.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Information Science and Technology - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Faculties are friendly, placements are in your head. Working hard gets you placed in a good company.

review_content.Placements: Placements are good enough. Working hard matters, and it's on the individual. If you work hard you will get placed in a good company. Many companies are visiting but the company sees the individual effort and skills, so it focuses on skills and works hard for a successful life.
review_content.Infrastructure: Not-so-good infrastructure because the construction works are still going on. Classrooms are good. There are smart classes. Boards and smart boards are present. Faculty members use both to teach us. There is enough material to study and they are completed for the exams.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Technology (Big Data) - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Overall, I am satisfied with the college I chose.

review_content.Placements: 80 to 90 percent of students got placement in our course. The highest package offered is 25.5 LPA, and the lowest package offered is 5.5 LPA. The average package offered is 7 LPA, and the top recruiting companies include HCL, Microsoft, Accenture, Infosys, etc. Approximately 70 to 85 percent of students secured internships with companies such as HCL, Infosys, Microsoft, etc.
review_content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure are good for our course, which provides Wi-Fi, labs, advanced classrooms, and a library. We get proper hygienic food in the hostel and canteen. We will get immediate medical facilities, sports, and games are very much available, which we can play whichever we are interested in.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Sc. in Multimedia - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Given a good amount of placements in 2024, really good infrastructure and facilities.

review_content.Placements: Most of my seniors have been placed in my course. The lowest package was around 1,50,000 per year, and the maximum was 24,00,000 per annum. Most of them get internships from my course. Some of them are going to animation companies. The top roles offered in my course are animator, graphic designer, video editor, cinematographer, director, story writer, etc.
review_content.Infrastructure: All my department labs are totally connected with Wi-Fi in the world university. The Wi-Fi connection is very good. Classes are well-maintained and totally furnished. The library has a lot of books. The hostel quality is also good. It is in a good area. The food quality is also nice. Even hostels have their own medical area, sports area, and indoor games. There is also a gym.

reviews_list.batch_info: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2023
reviews_list.review_title: This is the best University for MBA Course.

review_content.Placements: Approximately 85 to 95 percent of students were placed in our course. The highest package offered was 18LPA, the average package offered was 9LPA, and the lowest salary offered was 3LPA. Top organisations that hire from our course include Aravind, Raymond, Vardhman, and others. Almost all students have the opportunity to complete internships in various companies. The most common assignments included quality executives, supervisors, and so on.
review_content.Infrastructure: They assist us in establishing hands on EC in labs from the beginning. Wi-Fi was also available in the first year, and we must obtain the password from the appropriate department. Students can enter their registration number and password. The restaurant serves both vegetarian and vegan cuisine, as well as appetisers, Dahi Wada, and other options.

review_summary.college_name: Prince Shri Venkateshwara Padmavathy Engineering College Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: College is very old-fashioned and the worst.

content.Placements: 80% of students got placed from my course, and it is divided into separate classes by average and bright students. They give more importance to bright students. Students gets placed in companies like Cognizant and Movate, only some amount of students gets internships.
content.Infrastructure: Hostel students describe their hostel life as bad. They find insects in their hostel food. Hostel food is very bad in price. Most students won't even eat. You can go and come whenever you want from hostel. Hostel facility is very poor. It is very bad.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: Outstanding learning experience with practical insights.

content.Placements: 80% of the students were placed from the course. The highest package - is 4.5 LPA, the lowest package - is 2.5 LPA, average package - is 3 LPA. TCS, Infosys, Sutherland, Tata-related companies, more, etc. Software engineer, testing, vice process data analyst. Most students got internships and they were also placed in the same companies.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure for the courses varied from different departments. The facilities are very good and clean, library looks silent and peaceful. The hostel was clean and neat, the food was medium, and the medical facilities and sports were a very high priority.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: My college life - The teachers are well trained.

content.Placements: Many companies visited my college, including MNCs, Wipro, Infosys, Tech Mahindra, and Accenture. The teachers give training to students three months prior to get better placements. The highest package is 2 lakhs per year. 95% of students were placed in the top companies.
content.Infrastructure: For my subject, there are 3 staff members. For each subject, one staff member will teach, and another two will inspect us. Lab fees are around 6500, and the breakage fee is around 500. The hostel fee is 90,000, and the quality of food is also very hygienic. They provide the food on time.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Quite disappointed by the college curriculum and placements, wish they develop it soon.

content.Placements: The placements in the college are very average. I'm from the 2020-2024 batch and we hardly had 4 companies on campus and around 8 off-campus placements. Most of the companies that came for placement offered around 2.5 to 3 LPA, and the top company that came for placement was Accenture. Around 25 female candidates were placed.
content.Infrastructure: Labs are pretty decent but not enough equipment. Hostels are available for boys and girls separately, but the food is mediocre. There's a big ground in college, but it's used only once or twice a year for sports events; the rest of the time, it's used as a parking lot for college buses.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: If you want a degree with a reasonable price and more knowledge with less college enjoyment.

content.Placements: In my course, only a few students got placed in companies like HCL, TCS, and some more companies. The highest and the lowest packages offered by the course are 15 to 10 LPA. The top recruiting companies are HCL, TCS, Azure, etc. The percentage of students who got internships from these companies is high, and the roles offered to them are from freshers to HR.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure and design of the college campus buildings are good. There are two blocks: one is the main block and the other is the PG block. There are also separate blocks for the mechanical and civil departments. The classrooms have their own Wi-Fi connections for students. The quality of the food in the canteen is not good, and there are no medical facilities inside the college. There is a sports complex block for using sports equipment, and there is also a gym inside the complex.

reviews.review_heading: Supportive campus with good placements, strong scholarships and student life.
reviews.review_text: The college has decent infrastructure that helps learning. Classrooms are spacious, labs are useful, Wi-Fi works well, and the library is well-maintained. Hostel facilities are safe and comfortable. The food is hygienic, medical help is available, and sports facilities support both indoor and outdoor games for a balanced student life.

reviews.review_heading: A good engineering college, and it will be a value-for-money education.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms and library was good, and on the campus, free Wi-Fi facilities are available. In labs, the systems are all very good. Separate labs are given for each department, and the labs are very comfortable with AC, neat and clean.

reviews.review_heading: A good place for the right path of career education.
reviews.review_text: The college hostel infrastructure is really good. The lab facilities and Wi-Fi facilities are all available in our college. In our library, free Wi-Fi is available, and the food will be of such quality and hygienic that there will be veg and non-veg provided in the mess and also the canteen.

reviews.review_heading: Teachers are friendly. It provides good placements.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is beautiful. Classrooms are also good. Labs are well-equipped with air conditioning. It has high-speed internet connectivity. Many technical and financial books are available in the library. The hostel facilities are good with an attached bathroom. The canteen is also available. Medical facilities are good.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely best and great college.
reviews.review_text: Our college infrastructure was good. The classrooms were neat with comfortable benches and sufficient labs. Many technical and financial books were available in the library. Wi-Fi facility was also available. Hostel facilities were good. The canteen was also available. Medical facilities were available.

The department features modern classrooms with smart boards and digital teaching tools, promoting interactive learning. It houses several advanced computer laboratories with high-speed internet, the latest software, and high-performance systems to support programming, artificial intelli...

reviews.review_heading: PSNA College of Engineering and Technology has the best placements and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: This college has a well-maintained campus. More classrooms and modern laboratories are available in this college. The biggest library facilities are also there in this college. This college provides good hostel facilities for boys and girls. Hostel rooms are daily maintained very cleanly. Hostel food taste is also good. Sports grounds and coaching staff facilities are also available in this college.

reviews.review_heading: A very good college if you are searching for the best engineering college in Tamil Nadu.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available for the students and classrooms are neat and clean. The entire infrastructure of the college is green. It's such a peaceful environment where we can study peacefully. The hostel and mess foods are too good. We also have a big playground for sports and a lot of facilities available for sports and games.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, without expectations, students can enjoy their college life if they make good friends.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are designed for the convenience of students with wide space and projectors for easy or smart learning, The auditorium is built with centralised air-conditioner and has comfortable chairs with proper lighting, The library has a wide variety of books.

reviews.review_heading: Review of PSNA College of Engineering and Technology.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available for my course are good. It provides Wi-Fi. Classrooms include library and labs. Mess and canteen facilities are available. Sports and games facilities are also available. The food quality is good.

reviews.review_heading: College you will never regret.
reviews.review_text: In my college, they provide sufficient room for the hostels and games like football court, tennis court, shuttle court, and they also conduct game competitions and others. They provide healthy food for the hostel, and it is the safest place for girls to stay who are coming from long distances.

reviews.review_heading: Good college and well-maintained.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is good. Everyone can use the internet. It has a huge central library, and classrooms are good, clean, and hygienic. The labs are well-equipped. The hostel facility for both boys and girls. Our college has a canteen with some snacks. The medical facilities also available.

reviews.review_heading: Review of PSNA College of Engineering and Technology.
reviews.review_text: The Wi-Fi is present and installed everywhere except some places. The Wi-Fi password is kept secret to this date, and only the faculty members and the staff are allowed to use it, but no worries because the network is damn slow and not available inside the classrooms, only available in the lab for the faculty members only. Many of the lab systems are not capable of running a C program. Hostel food is below average; the taste of the hostel food and the canteen foods and drinks is getting even wor...

reviews.review_heading: Not worth it if you are not interested in self-learning.
reviews.review_text: There is a rare allowance for using the institution's Wi-Fi, and it is very slow. The mess and canteen are more expensive compared to the city market, and some dishes are not worth it. The service is also poor in the main canteen. The lab systems are very slow, even for basic working and functions such as browsing and system administration operations. The systems in the DSP lab are not capable.

reviews.review_heading: Fees are high, but the quality is good.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is below average. There is no library. Classrooms conditions are the worst, with only dim lighting, and sometimes mosquitoes bite us. Wi-Fi is not available. College does not have a hostel. Labs are in very bad condition, and the toilets are also poorly maintained.

faqs.answer: The Round 4 cutoff for JEE Main 2025 at Pondicherry Engineering College seat allocation has been officially announced for B.E./B.Tech. admissions. individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Chemical Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: It is a nice place to build our career.

content.Placements: Placements are quite good. My seniors are getting placed in Wabag, Chennai. Some other good companies also hire students. Packages offered are quite good for those who have nice company. For internships, faculty members will give permission to some of the popular institutes and industries.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities are good. The network connection is quite poor, to be honest. We have library facilities. Our college conducts tournaments every year for all sports. Inter-college matches are available for all sports. The canteen food is below average.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Chemical Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: It's a decent university.

content.Placements: The placements are very average. On average, only 4-5 students get placed. The package for the placed students is pretty decent. It's mainly up to the students. Their level of understanding of the course and how up-to-date they are plays a major role.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is decent. Some lab equipment needs to be upgraded. The classrooms are spacious and neat. There is a dispensary within the campus grounds with a nurse and a doctor always on call during working hours. The library has a good collection of books that can be used for reference. The sports and games area is also decent.

individual_reviews.course: M.Tech. in Data Science - Batch of 2019
individual_reviews.title: Good college and infrastructure.

content.Placements: 5th semester students are eligible for the placements. Not many companies 2 to 4 companies visited our college. They selected a few candidates by interview. Students are doing jobs in corporations. The highest package offered was 3.2LPA and the lowest package offered was 1.8LPA.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure was good for a engineering college. ATM and a bank inside the college. There was a garden that contained a good space for entertainment. Labs were spacious and had a good number of pc. Classrooms were spacious and digitally updated. The hostel was good. Mess food was average. There was a cricket ground volleyball court badminton court and indoor playground available.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Puducherry Technological University.

content.Placements: The average package is about 6 LPA, but the highest can be up to 18-20 LPA, and you also get an internship in big companies like Qualcomm and more. The rest is up to you, the harder you work, the more you will get. The T&P cell helps you get a job.
content.Infrastructure: Hostel life is very good. The food is a little bit average because most of the dishes are south indian, but the taste is very decent and much better than the other college hostel and mess. You can request the menu change as the menu is decided by the students only.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechatronics Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Satisfactory college with decent faculty members and placements.

content.Placements: Placements are decent. Most of the students get placed in various companies. The minimum package is 3 LPA, and the median is about 6.5 LPA. The faculty members, especially the training and placement cell help a lot in the placement. Around 45 out of 60 got placed.
content.Infrastructure: Campus has a central Wi-Fi that works all over the campus. The campus is also very big. Library has more than 8,000 books on all streams of engineering. Classrooms are decent.
content.Faculty: Curriculum is very good. The teaching quality is also very good, except for some teachers who make college life feel like school life, rest are all good. The exams are comparatively medium level. Sometimes the board asks very tough questions but generally easy. Faculty members are also very good and supportive, except for some.

reviews.review_heading: College is very good. Whoever joined the college will have good future.
reviews.review_text: In our college, the infrastructure is good. Wi-Fi is better. Our labs are very good now. Classrooms are also very good. The library is a bit better. reviews.review_heading: Satisfied because of good lectures.

reviews.review_heading: The college is good but the fee structure is too high.
reviews.review_text: The canteen and medical facilities were good and available during all college hours. The labs were mostly equipped with the latest Wi-Fi systems, and the classrooms, labs, and library were equipped with projectors for live classes.

reviews.review_heading: Facilities and infrastructure are good.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good, but the hostel food is not satisfactory. In labs, from the second year, all computers are functioning properly, but in the first year, 5 to 10 computers are not working properly. The hostel mess timings are from 7:30 to 9:00 AM for breakfast, 12:40 to 1:30 PM for first-year students, and 1:30 to 2:20 PM for the 2nd, 3rd, and 4th-year students, with dinner from 8:00 to 10:30 PM.

reviews.review_heading: It is good, but the college needs to improve more in facilities, quality of education, and placement
reviews.review_text: The labs, Wi-Fi, classrooms, and library are available, but they are generally basic facilities. individual_reviews.title: It has a very strict environment with only hope to complete 4 years soon.

content.Placements: Placements are above average here, and about 85-90% of students get placed. The highest salary package offered is 65 LPA, and the lowest package salary package offered is 3 LPA. The average salary package offered ranges from 5-7 LPA. Top recruiting companies like Zoho, Amazon, TCS, Infosys, Wipro, and Mindtree visit the college to hire students. faqs.answer: To apply for TNEA 2026, candidates have to meet the below requirements: Candidates must have passed the 10+2 exam with a minimum of 45% marks (40% for reserved category candidates). They should have passed the 10+2 exam from Tamil Nadu board or any equivalent board. They must have cleared any one of the HSC (Vocational Subject) with one of the Engineering related subjects namely Mathematics, Physics or Chemistry. Apart from that, they following requirements must be also met: Tamil Nadu candidates who have passed their Class VIII to Class XII standard in Tamil Nadu. Children of Central Government Employees, irrespective of their nativity, provided their parents or guardians (only if both parents are not alive) have been serving in Tamil Nadu continuously for the past five years at the time of TNEA application form submission. Sons/daughters of All India Service Tamil Nadu cadre officers. Children of employees in the Public Sector or Government recognised institutions who at the time of TNEA 2026 application form submission had been working in their organisations for the past five years are also eligible to apply, irrespective of their domicile. Other state candidates who have studied from Class VIII to Class XII in Tamil Nadu can also apply for TNEA 2026. Tamil Nadu native candidates who have passed any of the VIII, IX, X, XI and XII standards or their equivalent examinations from schools situated outside Tamil Nadu can also apply for TNEA.

hostel.description: All the hostels are provided with dining halls, uninterrupted water supply, reading halls, Internet connection, indoor recreation, television, and 24/7 medical facility. Each room have attached bathroom facility.

library.description:
Rajalakshmi Institute of Technology's library has a rich collection of 18328 volumes of textbooks and reference books in all branches of engineering, science, technology, management and general studies. All the books in the library are bar-coded; bar code system is followed in all transactions of the library. The college has a subscription of 38 printed national journals and 26 magazines including the subscription of IEEE online. The Electronic Library section also has a rich collection of more than 900 CD-ROMs. The library is well equipped with computerized On-line Public Access Catalogue (OPAC).

The books are classified according to the Dewey decimal classification system. Open access system is followed in the library.

reviews.review_heading: Highly satisfied with joining RIT.
reviews.review_text: Amazing facilities and infrastructure were available in our college. We have specialized labs for our course, and Wi-Fi is available on each floor. The hostel is maintained very well, and the quality of the food is great, but it's repetitive. The canteen is maintained to high standards, and medical facilities are available here with our own group's medical college, where any serious health issues can be treated, other than first aid. Yearly, twice sports activities will be conducted.

reviews.review_heading: I made a good decision on joining this college because of the great exposure I received.
reviews.review_text: Only the classrooms were non-AC rooms. Other than that, every place like the seminar hall, library, laboratories, and computer labs were maintained with AC infrastructure. The quality of the faculty is absolutely fine. They are kind and helpful, and the mess and canteen are maintained hygienically. Medical facilities are available, and they immediately take students to the institutional medical college.

reviews.review_heading: Good placement in 2025, where each student was able to receive nearly 2 to 3 placement offers.
reviews.review_text: College premises have the best infrastructure. Here, we maintain Wi-Fi for each floor, which has its own Wi-Fi. The labs and classrooms are well-maintained. AC is only available in the library, laboratory, and computer labs. In the classroom, there is no air conditioning available. Hostel food was fine to eat, but it was quite repetitive.

reviews.review_heading: No value for money, the worst management, with poor infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Very poor facility and management, we have to clean the rooms, there is no proper room service, the food will be okay, not much, and no proper sports ground. If we complain about anything to the management, there will be no proper response from the management, and mainly, to have this all, we need a hostel, but here there is no hostel. We have moved to 3 places without proper facilities provided by the management. Very worst hostel facility.

reviews.review_heading: My college is pleasant, and I am satisfied with faculty’s teaching methods.
reviews.review_text: In my department, we have a Wi-Fi connection in our block. There are a sufficient number of labs to perform course-related activities. Classrooms are properly cleaned, but they are non-AC. If a student faces any health issues, they are first treated with first aid, and if anything serious occurs, they are taken to the hospital. The mess and canteen are maintained clean and hygienic. Cultural events are conducted on campus, and intercollege sports matches are also organized.

reviews.review_heading: Average college with good exposure, they help in research and other stuff.
reviews.review_text: Good laboratories, well-equipped faculty members, and smart TV-equipped classrooms and libraries with a huge number of books for reference. Centralized Wi-Fi access, well-equipped labs, and classrooms. Classrooms contain either a projector or a smart TV for presentation and teaching.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is also good. The facilities are extraordinary. Wi-Fi is available in labs, classrooms, and in the library. Hostel food is also good. Canteen food is affordable, and the food quality is also good in the canteen. Medical facilities are also available inside the campus.

reviews.review_heading: Good college for placements.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure in our college is also good. Wi-Fi is available throughout the campus, in classrooms as well as in the library. Hostel infrastructure is good, but the boys’ hostel is not inside the campus. Food is also good in the mess and canteen. Medical facilities, sports, and games are also good.

reviews.review_heading: Success is not a destination, success is a journey.
reviews.review_text: More than 8 lakh square feet of space in Chennai is set up to house all the classrooms, drawing halls, laboratories, workshops, and technology, hosting more than 700 computers, an administrative block, and NDA exception. The college has separate hostel facilities for boys and girls and is equipped with all modern amenities.

reviews.review_heading: Good college for placement.
reviews.review_text: I am a hosteller, there are three hostels in this college IMA hostel, RIT hostel, and RMC hostel. When I am a fresher, they allotted RMC hostel for all boys and some girls also. Basically RMC is a medical college under Rajalakshmi, and its infrastructure is best compared to other hostels.

reviews.review_heading: Success is not a destination, and it is a journey.
reviews.review_text: Rajalakshmi Institute of Technology provides separate hostel facilities for both boys and girls within the campus, offering a conducive environment for academic pursuits. Hostels are equipped with dining halls, internet access, and medical assistance.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Rajalakshmi Institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text: RIT provides a range of infrastructure facilities for both academic and residential purposes. These include well-equipped classrooms, laboratories, a library, a computer centre, and a sports complex. For students residing in the hostel, RIT offers water supply, Internet, and a 24/7 medical facility.

reviews.review_heading: Success is not a destination, success is a journey.
reviews.review_text: The college provides separate hostels for boys and girls with dining halls, internet and washing machines. This RIT campus is affiliated with Anna University, Chennai. The college presently offers 18 undergraduate and 9 postgraduate programmes including an MBA programme.

reviews.review_heading: Success is not a destination, success is a journey.
reviews.review_text: We have Wi-Fi in every block. Classrooms are digital. We have Wi-Fi and washing machines are available in our hostel. Hostel food is average. The canteen is available in the hostel and campus.

reviews.review_heading: The pro is that it is a good college, and the con is campus is small.
reviews.review_text: It has a good centre of excellence. There are 14 centres in the college. Our college has a center for artificial intelligence, a center for smart manufacturing, a center for mobility and energy, a center for data science, a center for Apple, and a center for AR/VR. It has 8 balanced centers.

hostel_campus.college_name: RGM College Infrastructure Details & Reviews

reviews.review_heading: Well-structured campus with good facilities and placement support.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure at RGMCET is good with well-maintained classrooms, Wi-Fi, computer labs, and a decent library. Hostel facilities are comfortable and kept clean. Mess food is good and hygienic. The campus also provides basic medical facilities along with good sports and recreation areas.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure, supportive faculty, and decent placements with scope for industry exposure.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides snacks and meals at reasonable prices. Medical facilities include a campus healthcare center with visiting doctors. Sports facilities include cricket, kabaddi, volleyball, basketball, kho-kho, and indoor games like chess for student recreation.

reviews.review_heading: It is really good infrastructure, good faculty, and good in extracurricular activities.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is common for all branches. Good facilities, clean, neat, peaceful. Food is very good compared to other hostels. There will be a peaceful lawn in the hostel, and food will also be provided for parents. Some programs will be held during festivals, freshers, and farewell for seniors. Even celebrities came to our college during fests.

reviews.review_heading: The teachers are experienced and highly qualified.
reviews.review_text: Facilities provided in our college are Wi-Fi, classrooms, library, canteen, CAD lab, and bookshop. The facilities in our hostel are Wi-Fi, washing machine, CCTV, food, and TV. The food in the canteen is nice, with reasonable prices and good quality. The medical facilities are also available in our college.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with campus life and placements, with an average experience with some faculty.
reviews.review_text: RGM hostels are known for tasty food, hygiene, and a clean environment. With feels around 1 Lacs, they offer great value. A large ground supports sports and co-curricular activities, making it ideal for both comfort and overall development. I recommend it.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfying experience, friendly faculty, good placements, and very well maintained.
reviews.review_text: Laboratories are well-equipped with computers and machinery. The classrooms have digital screens for easy teaching and proper understanding for the students. The internet is available all over the college campus, and the library is open to everyone till 8:00 PM. Hostel food is pretty decent, with a different variety of food every day and snacks every evening. Sports events are held every semester.

reviews.review_heading: Placements are good and if we are studying well, then definitely it is worth it here.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very good. It has a very nice library and well-equipped labs. A new block is under construction and almost finished. When it is available, there will be huge labs and classrooms with the best infrastructure. It is expected to inaugurate a new block in 3-4 months.

reviews.review_heading: I'm satisfied. I would recommend someone to choose our college.
reviews.review_text: College have quality education with good infrastructure like labs, classrooms, digital boards, and libraries. Everything is good and the ambulance service is also there for anytime emergency.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied because of faculty and their quality education.
reviews.review_text: Labs, classrooms, and the library, along with proficient lecturers, were available. The quality of food was good, with no restrictions or limits. An ambulance was also available. Sports and games were also conducted by the college. The environment was very good. I would suggest this college to those who were really interested in gaining knowledge.

reviews.review_heading: It is an absolutely good college with good infrastructure, but the placement percentage is low.
reviews.review_text: Our college includes labs, Wi-Fi facilities, classrooms, and a huge library with good infrastructure. The hostel is very secure, with healthy food provided. The medical facilities are splendid. Sports and games are also provided. They encourage us to participate in tournaments.

reviews.review_heading: The college campus is good and peaceful. Faculty is friendly to everyone.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of my college is very peaceful. Smartboards, Wi-Fi, labs, and a big library are there. In the hostel, the food is good and tasty. All good facilities are there. There is an ambulance for emergency purposes. There is a huge ground. Every year, the college conducts a sports day.

reviews.review_heading: Provide good faculty in each department.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available now. In hostels, once upon a time, there were no cameras, but now cameras are available. Labs, classrooms, and the library are very good. Now the library is very good. In the hostel, there is no quality food. Weekly, thrice the food is not good. Except for the hostel food, all are good.

reviews.review_heading: Endless nights at RGM college.
reviews.review_text: College feels fresh and pleasant. Environment is very good. There are grounds for sports like cricket, basketball, and badminton court. Hostel rooms are provided with free Wi-Fi. Classrooms are digital and libraries are also digitialised. Laundry is provided. Lockers are given in hostel rooms for students, bed, pillows, and carts are provided.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied because of faculty, good placements in 2024.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, labs, classes, library in all places, total around Wi-Fi is there and available. Courses are CSE general and sub-branches like AI/ML, cybersecurity, data science, etc. Sports are good, we have a large ground. Food is good at the canteen and hostel. All infrastructure is available for my course.

reviews.review_heading: Good experience at RGMCET.
reviews.review_text: The facilities provided by our college, such as Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and libraries are excellent. There is a central library in our college that provides lots of knowledge for us. The food provided in our hostel is too good and healthy. They also provide free medical services. Every year there will be a sports meet in our college.

admission_process.title: REVA University Bengaluru Admission Process 2026

paragraphs: REVA University Bangalore admissionis completely entrance-based. The admission process starts with theregistration for REVA CET. This is a common exam conducted for admitting students to most of the UG & PG courses of REVA University. Candidates interested in admissions at REVA Bangalore can check the following elaborated steps:

REVA University Bengaluru accepts applications for both national and international aspirants. However, to be eligible to take admission, first submit the application form on time in an online mode. The REVA University accepts applications for its REVA CET exam. Applicants also have to pay an application fee ofINR 1,000. However, candidates can also apply without REVA CET scores directly on the application portal.

After successfully filling the application form, candidates will be shortlisted based on REVA CET exam scores. Furthermore, REVA Bangalore also accepts scores of various state/ national-level exams for courses such as BTech, MBA, MCA, etc. Candidates applying through the scores of any other entrance exam will be exempted from REVA CET.

Based on past academic records and entrance exam scores, eligible candidates will be shortlisted. Further, the university will conduct a common counselling process for the final seat allotment to selected candidates.

paragraphs: REVA University has released the placement stats for the batch passing out in 2025. The highest package offered during REVA University placements 2025 stood at INR 40 LPA . Further, over 621 companies participated in the placement process and presented 4,482 job offers to the students of the batch 2025. Apart from this, 3 international offers, 178 super dream offers, and 1,449 dream offers have been made during REVA University placements in 2025.

A total of 2,329 internship offers were provided to the students duirng the placememt session 2025. The highest stipend offered during the 2025 placement session stood at INR 1 lakh per month . The top recruiters of REVA University Bangalore placements in recent years include Bosch, Kyndryl, Happiest Minds, DXC Technology, Cognizant, etc. IT and Software was among the top sector with offer distribution of 25%.
Earlier, the highest package secured by the students of the School of Business batch 2024 was INR 12 LPA . This package was offered by Deltax.

reviews.review_heading: It has good infrastructure and facilities. Faculty members are quite helpful.
reviews.review_text: The library is open till midnight for studies. The hostel experience is above average. Medical facilities are provided on campus. It also has indoor and outdoor sports. The mess food can be eaten, and weekly they serve non-veg food thrice, which is generally nice. Labs are quite helpful.

reviews.review_heading: Decent placements, good student life.
reviews.review_text: Very good quality food is available in the food court, good medical facilities with emergency services. A large sports ground with lots of games, Wi-Fi is pretty fast for normal work with a wireless network around 100 Mbps and wired labs around 1 Gbps, a massive library with all relevant materials which are also uploaded online and can be accessed through their website, and smart classrooms with smartboards, TV, projector, and a green board.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Reva University.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our campus is so good compared to other universities in Bangalore. Every facility in our department is top-notch like labs, a library, smart classrooms, Wi-Fi, clubs for arts, singing, dancing, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with this college.
reviews.review_text: Our college infrastructure is very good. The food court is also nice. We get all types of food items there. Even in our block, we have nice canteens where we can get snacks. Our college has many stalls like Maggi Point, Panchami Sagar, Nandini Cafe, and others.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements and a huge campus.
reviews.review_text: Our college has speed Wi-Fi, good food. There are mess, canteens and quality food is served. There is also a medical room for treatment of fever for temporary use, there is a huge ground where people play around and its kind of a park. There are different games played like athletics, basketball, kabaddi and some other sports.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure, decent staff, and good placement.
reviews.review_text: Hostels are well maintained and have Wi-Fi. Food is decent. Medical facilities are available inside the campus, but there is no CCTV in classrooms. Labs are well-equipped, and all types of instruments are available. Classrooms are very well-equipped with smart boards.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: There is great infrastructure in Reva University, there is a 24/7 Wi-Fi facility, labs, and classrooms are great, and the library is so big, and all books are available. For hostelers, it is available up to midnight, and hostel and mess food is also hygienic.

reviews.review_heading: It has really good infrastructure and a good crowd.
reviews.review_text: There are enough facilities in our hostel, including Wi-Fi, 24/7 hot water, and AC. The hostel food is good, with three meals and evening snacks. Each department has a separate library. There is also a central library with Wi-Fi. It is one of the best campuses in Bangalore. Along with facilities like a salon, novelty store, stationery and healthcare centre, food court, indoor sports arena, and fitness centre.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, a good college for the MBA course.
reviews.review_text: The campus is stunning and has everything we could possibly need. In addition to having large classrooms, labs, Wi-Fi, and libraries. The hostel is, to be honest, subpar and more costly than the college tuition. It has mediocre amenities, and the cuisine is undoubtedly a concern.

reviews.review_heading: Good college that provides various opportunities.
reviews.review_text: We get clean and neat washrooms, water facilities, and hygienic food. Food in hostels is repetitive as they have fixed a timetable for each day. Sports and games are optional and depend on personal preference. Hostel maintenance is very good and acceptable.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and facilities, and we can expect our future here.
reviews.review_text: Facilities like computer labs, Wi-Fi & Internet, library, resource center, seminar halls & auditorium, well-maintained indoor and outdoor door games, on-campus medical centre, trained medical staff, nutritionists, hygienic food, and spacious and well-maintained rooms are available.

reviews.review_heading: College looks nice and beautiful campus, but placements are average for the fee we pay.
reviews.review_text: Coming to the infrastructure, the college looks really neat and colourful thanks to the maintenance department from the college workers over there, and the hostel is also really good, but the fee is slightly high, and there are restrictions in the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: REVA has good infrastructure , qualified teachers ,good placements ,Hostel rooms were big
reviews.review_text:
REVA has best infrastructure .Classrooms are really good even have smart classes . Washrooms are super clean and hygenic . Campus has a very good environment as well. Campus grounds are so well maintained.college library has books from almost all fields, interesting novels as well.
Mess has different food for breakfast lunch and dinner as per their schedule.
Canteens are have quality food at best price
Medical facilities are good

reviews.review_heading: Really good placements in 2025.
reviews.review_text: The Wi-Fi is not good, its always getting disconnected, and we need to connect again and again. It becomes somewhat difficult for us, so I prove that we can do it. The library is good, the environment is also good, we have so many trees on campus, which makes us feel good.

reviews.review_heading: This college is good. If students are interested, then they can join this college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is nice, and I like it. The hostel fee and the college fee are a little expensive. If we put extra effort, then we will achieve success in our lives. There is a little issue with the lab faculty members, as they are not very good.

admission_process.title: Saveetha Engineering College Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: Saveetha Engineering College admissionis both merit and entrance-based and requires students to provide valid scores obtained in the accepted entrance test. The college offers BTech, M.E, MBA and PhD programmes at undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral levels respectively. Also known asSEC Chennai, the admission process of the college can be completed either online or offline depending on the candidate's performance. The programmes are provided in affiliation withAnna University. Interested students can read the following article to know all about the programmes and their respective admission criteria and procedures at SEC Chennai.

The college offers undergraduate and postgraduate courses across various specialisations and aspirants need to apply for courses through the official website.Saveetha Engineering College course admissionfor BE/ BTech is via TNEA. The selection for M.E and MBA is based on entrance exam scores. The college offers courses inEngineering, Science, IT & Software etc. Students need to appear for the college-level aptitude test or provide a valid score obtained in the accepted exam. The following table mentions the eligibility and selection ofSaveetha Engineering College courses:

Saveetha Engineering College admissionis primarily entrance-based. Candidates must register for the course on the university's official website and proceed with the admission process. Check the following section to know the detailed steps for theSaveetha Engineering College admission process:

SEC, Chennai application process is conducted online. Candidates have to fill out an online application form on the college's official website. Along with that, candidates must also pay an application fee and submit the relevant documents of their previous academics.

Admission to PG courses at Saveetha Engineering College is entrance-based, whereas, for UG courses, candidates are selected via the TNEA counselling process. Further, candidates must also qualify for entrance exams such as XAT, TANCET, GATE, etc., for admission to specific PG courses. However, admission to BTech is done via TNEA Counselling and past academic scores of candidates. Students need to appear for the college-level aptitude test (SEAT for BTech, SMART for MBA) as well.
Once the selection rounds are over, the SEC releases a merit list to announce the names of the selected candidates.
STEP 4: Seat Allotment via Counselling Process

Candidates whose names appear on the merit list are called for the counselling process. The final seat allotment is done either through TNEA Counselling or the Consortium of Self-Financing Professional, Arts and Science Colleges in Tamil Nadu for the respective courses. Shortlisted aspirants need to pay theSEC feeto confirm their seat in the college.

reviews.review_heading: The college is a well-developed campus with Wi-Fi network and good placements with flexi learn.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is good, with well-equipped hi-tech labs and the whole campus is covered with IPvD Wi-Fi connectivity. The classrooms look decent. The food in the canteen is good, and the mess also seems good.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with the teaching of faculty, good placement in 2025, really good facilities.
reviews.review_text: College has a good facility of flexible learning. In flexible learning, students can choose their own faculty and the subjects they are going to study. College has good infrastructure like a big canteen, 40 Mbps speed of Wi-Fi for phones and 100 Mbps speed of Wi-Fi for laptops, air conditioning in every classroom and library with every facility. Hostel has good AC rooms, food is very tasty. It has a medical clinic for hostel students near the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: This college has nice environment.
reviews.review_text: The faculty in this college is very helpful in many ways to the students. The faculty has many years of experience in teaching and provides great lessons to the students. There are many labs and a spacious library. There are many canteens available in the college.

reviews.review_heading: It has good infrastructure, supportive faculty and decent placement opportunities in CSE.
reviews.review_text: Saveetha Engineering College has good infrastructure for B.E CSE with smart classrooms, high speed Wi-Fi, well equipped computer labs, and a rich library. Hostels are clean and secure, food quality is good, medical facilities are available. Sports and recreation facilities are well maintained.

reviews.review_heading: The college faculty members are good, but the placements are only average.
reviews.review_text: The Wi-Fi facility is average, but the classrooms have better infrastructure.

reviews.review_heading: College life is good but not in placements.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of the college and hostel is good. Wi-Fi in the college is good but not good in hostel classrooms have AC but the quality of food is not good in the mess but good in the canteen. Medical facilities are good apart from that sports and games are average.

reviews.review_heading: Good college. Helpful for the students who score more cut off.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure of the college is good. It is a unique infrastructure in Tamil Nadu. SMART room class eg. Attendance are taken by QR method. In the hostel, I think the quality of food is good, they give more variety. Nearby Medical College and hospital are here.

reviews.review_heading: Good campus life and overall facilities .
reviews.review_text:
Good customized and digitalized classrooms and good 
Restroom and canteen facilities across the campus. Best laboratories with availability of all equipments. Good hostel facility with NEET mess and Wi-Fi facilities. Here courses are mainly focused on theory related practical which enables provides us industrial based learning and training.

reviews.review_heading: Good in everything except food.

It is most useful to us when the quality of food is too low it is not good. I will not prefer my hostel food. Sometimes we have bugs in our food, which may cause health issues but we have medical facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements are coming if you have talent, do not wait for it.
reviews.review_text: Our college has all kinds of things like free Wi-fi and lab facilities. That all on the first floor with no facilities are above floors. Foods are not bad but compared to others okay its enough for us. Hostels have both AC and non AC.

reviews.review_heading: I feel good about the hostel building, and facilities are comfortable for my studies.

reviews.review_heading: This year's placement is good, the highest is 44 LPA, and this is the best college for placement.

review_summary.college_name: Dwarkadas J. Sanghvi College of Engineering Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: DJ Sanghvi in a nutshell.

content.Placements: The placement scene is quite good; based on my observations, it’s above 90% with many people placed in JP Morgan, UBS, ZS, and other prominent companies. Furthermore, the placement cell is very helpful and assists in many fields. In addition to placements, there is also an internship fair conducted to give students the opportunity to gain experience.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure consists of a six-story building. There is no ground or any area for sports, but considering the college's location, it is acceptable. The entire college is air-conditioned except for the corridors. There are labs for many subjects, and the canteen is also quite good. As for the hostel, the college doesn’t have one but is affiliated with a nearby option. However, I honestly wouldn’t recommend it as it’s very expensive, and you’ll have a better chance of finding another one.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: The honest review of DJ Sanghvi.

content.Placements: Almost 70% of students get placed this year. Though it was a bit frustrating at first, almost everyone who sat for placements got placed. The main advantage we have over others is that we are allowed to prepare for competitive exams like GATE and GRE while sitting for certain interviews (not for dream jobs and above). This option is not available in most colleges.
content.Infrastructure: Labs all have centralized AC and all the required software. The lab in charge is polite and experienced. Hostels are a bit costly compared to the services they provide. There are many stores and options to eat in the area, so students from outside have many options.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Review of Dwarkadas J. Sanghvi College of Engineering.

content.Placements: Placements in our college are great, but only for some branches. In branches like Mechanical and Electronics, placements are little to none. Even students who get placed have packages in the range of 3.5 to 8 LPA. About 45–50% of students receive placements.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities provided are above average, yet not up to the mark. Given the fee that one has to pay, the infrastructure can be much better. Opportunities for students interested in sports are little to none, and the college does not do anything about it.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Good placement percentage and very good infrastructure.

content.Placements: In my course (EXTC), around 80% of students were placed through the college. The highest package was 29 LPA, the average was 8 LPA, and the lowest was 4 LPA. Amazon and Google were the top recruiting companies for my course. The top role offered in the course was the tech head.
content.Infrastructure: You got everything you wanted, from libraries to the gym, but you didn't get a campus. Everything was top-notch here. You wouldn't feel like you were in a college. It would make you feel like you were in a 5-star hotel out of India, too.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Why you should come to DJ Sanghvi: Personal Review.

content.Placements: Our college has very good placements. In EXTC, about 80 percent of the students who sat for placements got it. Average 12 LPA, the highest is 42 LPA (so far), and the lowest maybe 4 LPA. Top recruiters are Google, L&T, etc. Internships are also amazing and in fact, Google picked up 4 kids for 1.5 Lacs per month this year.
content.Infrastructure: Our facilities are absolutely amazing. AC is everywhere, classrooms are good, and labs are fully equipped. Our seminar hall is beautiful, we have different departments for different branches. Our canteen is so good that people from different colleges come to sit there.

reviews.review_heading: DJ Sanghvi in a nutshell.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure consists of a six-story building. There is no ground or any area for sports, but considering the college's location, it is acceptable. The entire college is air-conditioned except for the corridors. There are labs for many subjects, and the canteen is also quite good. As for the hostel, the college doesn’t have one but is affiliated with a nearby option. However, I honestly wouldn’t recommend it as it’s very expensive, and you’ll have a better chance of finding another one.

reviews.review_heading: The honest review of DJ Sanghvi.
reviews.review_text: Labs all have centralized AC and all the required software. The lab in charge is polite and experienced. Hostels are a bit costly compared to the services they provide. There are many stores and options to eat in the area, so students from outside have many options.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Dwarkadas J. Sanghvi College of Engineering.
reviews.review_text: Facilities provided are above average, yet not up to the mark. Given the fee that one has to pay, the infrastructure can be much better. Opportunities for students interested in sports are little to none, and the college does not do anything about it.

reviews.review_heading: Good placement percentage and very good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: You got everything you wanted, from libraries to the gym, but you didn't get a campus. Everything was top-notch here. You wouldn't feel like you were in a college. It would make you feel like you were in a 5-star hotel out of India, too.

reviews.review_heading: Why you should come to DJ Sanghvi: Personal Review.
reviews.review_text: Our facilities are absolutely amazing. AC is everywhere, classrooms are good, and labs are fully equipped. Our seminar hall is beautiful, we have different departments for different branches. Our canteen is so good that people from different colleges come to sit there.

reviews.review_heading: The best college with the best teachers and environment.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is very good. Classrooms are very spacious and fully air conditioned. Labs are also equipped with modern amenities and tools and are fully air conditioned. Libraries are the best part of college. It has many books, journals, and articles from various great publications. All resources are available for postgraduate studies also. Canteen food is average but the infrastructure of the canteen is excellent .

reviews.review_heading: Insights of DJ Sanghvi College of Engineering.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good, but there is no campus; it's just a building of 6 floors. Although the labs and classrooms are centralized AC, and Wi-Fi is connected all the time. All the labs and classrooms have smart boards and whiteboards, which enhance the learning experience.

reviews.review_heading: My experience at Dwarkadas J. Sanghvi College of Engineering.
reviews.review_text: Each floor has two departments, which are well equipped with a good amount of labs and classrooms. Each floor is also equipped with Wi-Fi, which, however, has a firewall that seems to work quite effectively. The college also has an auditorium on the third floor, which is mostly used for events and stuff. Also, the college has a cafeteria on the ground floor with options for both indoor and outdoor sitting. The library on the first floor is also good enough but it can get crowded sometimes during...

reviews.review_heading: Review of D J Sanghavi  College
reviews.review_text: The facilities are quite average. The classroom are air-conditioned and the labs are air-conditioned too. Each labs has thirty two computers. The lift is not working since one year. The classrooms are decent some class don't have fans so ac not working is a problem

reviews.review_heading: Review of D.J Sanghavi College of Engineering.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is well maintained. The campus has wifi access throughout. The labs are air-conditioned and have computers of good quality that support various software. The classes are air-conditioned too. The library is also equipped with ample books.

reviews.review_heading: Review of D.J. Sanghavi College of Engineering.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good. The laboratory and classrooms are air-conditioned. The computers in the labs are well maintained. Wi-Fi access is available throughout the college. We have two lifts in working condition. We also have a canteen where the food is tasty and hygiene is maintained as well.

reviews.review_heading: College review of DJ Sanghvi
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is quite good, with air-conditioned rooms and labs that have Wi-Fi and PCs. The library has an extensive collection of different books, and the canteen offers a good variety of food. While it doesn’t include much in terms of sports and games, it has medical facilities and overall good amenities.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely best infrastructure and faculty.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is one thing our college is especially very good at. It has all sorts of modern amenities and labs, which are more than enough for a college student. The mess and canteen are clean and affordable for all students, and they provide quality and taste at a reasonable amount.

reviews.review_heading: All you need to know about Dwarkadas J Sanghvi College.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available throughout campus. Labs are state-of-the-art in college, with high-end PCs and lab equipment. The library is also state-of-the art with thousands of books. The hostel is a bit costly with all its facilities. The canteen is not so good. Medical facilities are available. Sports and games happen at events, not throughout the year.

reviews.review_heading: Placements and crowds are amazing. Everything else is bad.
reviews.review_text: Hostels are quite expensive (4 lacs per year). Lab batches are for more than 30 people (although the lab has enough space, it is not supposed to have more than 25 PPL in a batch). Wi-Fi is bad and most good websites don't work due to firewalls. The canteen is also bad.
